FFF0.name: reset_vector
FFF0.comment: CPU reset lands here (F000:FFF0). Far jump to POST entry.

E05B.name: post_entry
E05B.comment: POST entry point (classic IBM/Phoenix location F000:E05B).

E00E.name: ibm_signature
E00E.comment: 'IBM' at F000:E00E - compatibility marker checked by old software.

E2C3.name: int02_nmi_entry
E2C3.comment: Classic IBM INT 02h (NMI) entry - jmp to handler.

E401.name: hd_param_table
E401.comment: INT 41h/46h fixed-disk parameter table: 47 types x 16 bytes (E401..E6F0).

E739.name: int14_serial_entry
E739.comment: Classic IBM INT 14h (serial) entry point F000:E739: jmp to the INT 14h handler.

F065.name: int10_video_entry
F065.comment: Classic IBM INT 10h (video) entry - the C&T VGA ROM normally hooks INT 10h ahead of this.

F0A4.name: video_param_table
F0A4.comment: INT 1Dh video parameter table (CRTC register sets for MDA/CGA modes).

FA6E.name: font_8x8
FA6E.comment: INT 1Fh 8x8 character font, chars 00h-7Fh (1024 bytes, FA6E..FE6D).

FE6E.name: int1A_time_entry
FE6E.comment: Classic IBM INT 1Ah (time of day) entry.

FEF3.name: ivt_init_08_1F
FEF3.comment: Table of 24 near offsets used to initialise INT 08h..1Fh vectors (segment F000).

FF23.name: ivt_init_70_77
FF23.comment: Table of 8 near offsets used to initialise INT 70h..77h (slave PIC) vectors.

FF33.name: int_default_irq_handler
FF33.comment: Default handler for unused IRQs: sends EOI to both PICs, IRET.

FF53.name: int_dummy_iret
FF53.comment: Classic IBM FF53: IRET stub for INT 1Bh/1Ch etc.

58DA.name: post_start
58DA.comment: First real POST code. SS := F000 (read from the reset vector), SP points at a ROM word = return address (Phoenix ROM-stack idiom).

5A15.name: shutdown_dispatch
5A15.comment: Jump table indexed by CMOS shutdown status byte (0Fh): index = code-4, so entries cover shutdown codes 04h..0Ch; codes 0-3 take the normal cold-boot path (sub_5A92).

D309.name: print_inline_msg
D309.comment: Prints the NUL-terminated message that follows the CALL instruction, then returns past it.

D7F6.name: wait_refresh_cycles
D7F6.comment: Delay BX:CX refresh toggles (port 61h bit 4); every 64 ticks calls DX (callback returns ZF=1 to abort). Uses PIT ch1.

D4A1.name: bootsector_farptr
D4A1.comment: Far pointer 0000:7C00 - INT 19h jumps through it into the loaded boot sector (F000:792F).

D4A5.name: bda_segment_word
D4A5.comment: Word constant 0040h: BIOS data area segment.

D847.name: cmos_read
D847.comment: AL=index -> read CMOS byte via 70h/71h (with 0EDh I/O delay). Returns AL.

6D94.name: probe_port_table
6D94.comment: Walk up to 4 word entries at CS:SI; call DI for each non-zero port; set bit in BL per detected port (serial/parallel detection).

C00E.name: enter_protected_mode
C00E.comment: CR0.PE := 1, then far jump through selector 0038h (code segment aliasing F0000).

7236.name: setup_gdt_idt_low_ram
7236.comment: Builds a 256-entry IDT at 0000:D0A0 (all -> 71D6 in seg 40h?), copies GDT/IDT image from 714E to 0000:D8A0, lgdt/lidt, lmsw, far jump via selector 0040h.

9B73.name: copy_rom_to_ram
9B73.comment: Copies this ROM segment into RAM at DX:0000 (used before shadow-RAM enable: continues execution from 1000:99A6).

DB69.name: boot_call_bootsector_a
DB69.comment: Far call 07C0:0000 - jumps into the loaded boot sector.

7977.name: boot_fail_message
7977.comment: SI -> message. Unless suppressed by option flag (cs:[AF46] bit 5), prints it, waits for F1/F2 (F2 -> SETUP), then INT 18h and retries boot.

B86B.name: print_string_cs_si
B86B.comment: Prints NUL-terminated string at CS:SI via INT 10h teletype.

D236.name: dispatch_clamp_ah
D236.comment: DI = limit (2*N). Sets DI = AH*2 if AH < N else leaves DI = limit (default entry). Also DS := 0.

8A53.name: int16_handler
8A53.comment: INT 16h keyboard services body (E82E jumps here). 18 functions + default via jump table at 8A63.

D4B1.name: str_h_crlf
D4B1.comment: h + CR LF: hex-suffix terminator printed after a hex number.

D2FA.name: print_hex_value_h_crlf
D2FA.comment: Print string at SI, then value as hex, then h CR LF.

8C5C.name: kbd_special_scancodes
8C5C.comment: 28 scancodes with special handling in INT 09h (shift/ctrl/alt make+break, locks, insert, E0/E1 prefixes, ack/resend/overrun, PrtScr).

8C78.name: kbd_shift_flag_masks
8C78.comment: 16 bit-masks for 40:17/40:18 keyboard flag bytes, parallel to the first 16 special scancodes.

A6E0.name: wait_f1_f2_key
A6E0.comment: Waits for F1 (continue) / F2 (run SETUP) after a boot or POST error.

792C.name: boot_jump_to_sector
792C.comment: Boot sector signature valid: fix SP and far-jump via bootsector_farptr to 0000:7C00.

7EB1.name: int13h_status_epilogue_entry
7EB1.comment: Common exit of the hard-disk INT 13h handler: AH = status; for AH < 16h jump through int13h_status_epilogue_table to fix AL/CF per function, then pop and RETF 2.

0100.name: setup_far_entry
0100.comment: Far-callable SETUP utility entry (jmp 1934). Called by PhoenixMISER (E800:061D lcall F000:0100) and by the INT 09h Ctrl+Alt+S hotkey path.

E6F5.name: system_config_table
E6F5.comment: INT 15h AH=C0h system configuration table: length 0008h, model FCh, submodel 01h, BIOS revision 00h, feature byte 74h (2nd PIC, RTC, INT 15h 4Fh keyboard intercept, wait for external event), 4 reserved bytes; followed by vendor tags 0F 00 01 03 'PTL' 80 00 01 'ESS' 82 FF 00 F0 (ESS = the audio codec vendor, best guess).

1CD0.name: setup_cmos_correction_table
1CD0.comment: 8 records x 8 bytes: +0 message ptr, +2 flag mask tested against [bp+2F] correction flags, +4 mask to clear, +6 handler ptr. Drives the "SETUP has attempted to correct the following errors" screen.

1934.name: setup_main
1934.comment: SETUP utility body: sets 40:B5 bit0 (SETUP active), saves video mode/page/cursor, then runs the page loop. Returns via RETF from setup_far_entry.

1B18.name: setup_key_dispatch_loop
1B18.comment: Scan 3-byte (key, handler) records on the stack frame ([bp+4D] ASCII keys / [bp+5D] extended keys) and call the handler for the pressed key.

582E.name: post_fatal_error
582E.comment: AL = POST code. Writes it to port 80h; depending on ROM option flags at AF45 either halts (bit1), restarts POST (bit0), or sounds the beep code (5873) and halts.

5873.name: beep_code_and_halt
5873.comment: Sounds the failing POST code on the speaker: PIT ch2 tone (43h=B6h, 42h=04A8h), number of beeps derived from the code (BH), then HLT. Uses ROM-stack returns at 58A5/58BA/58CD.

5848.name: beep_delay_pit2
5848.comment: Delay loop by watching PIT channel 2 count down (CX iterations).

AF45.name: rom_option_flags
AF45.comment: Build-time option bytes: AF45=0Eh (bit1 halt on fatal, bit2, bit3 128 KB granularity), AF46=0Bh (bit0 CPU speed from CMOS, bit1 40:15 preset, bit3 display/CMOS 1Fh gating), AF47=E0h (bit7 alternate A20 method, bits 5-6), AF55=25h (bit0 speed-change click, bit2, bit5), AF56/AF57/AF58 = 48h/50h/50h hot-key scancodes (Up/Down arrows with Ctrl+Alt) for the CPU speed keys, AF59=02h floppy speed byte, AF5A=64h, AF5D/AF5E/AF5F = 02h/01h/00h the three CPU speed values written to chipset reg 300h.

5945.name: post_cold_entry
5945.comment: Cold/warm POST: NMI off, read chipset reg 1 (ports 24h/26h) bit 8 -> resume vector at 0040:0072; else read KBC status bit2 to pick CMOS 0Fh shutdown code.

59B5.name: init_pics_and_fpu
59B5.comment: Reset FPU (port F1h); program PIC2 (ICW1=15h, ICW2=70h, ICW3=02h, ICW4=01h, mask FFh) and PIC1 (ICW1=15h, ICW2=08h, ICW3=04h, ICW4=01h, mask FBh).

59EF.name: post_shutdown_select
59EF.comment: Temporary stack 0030:0080, DS=0. Shutdown code < 4 or > 0Ch -> normal boot path (5A92); else dispatch through shutdown_dispatch.

5A92.name: post_normal_path
5A92.comment: Normal cold/warm boot continues here: clear 40:72 unless code FCh, touch MSW, ROM-stack call sub_C388, then set CMOS 34h bit7, program refresh timer (PIT ch1 mode 2 count 12h), POST 91h, chipset reg 3 := 05E4h, call MISER API 24h (stub) via ROM-stack far return to 5B0A.

5B0A.name: post_after_miser_24
5B0A.comment: Return point after MISER API 24h; jumps to 95C4.

5B33.name: post_01_cpu_reg_test
5B33.comment: POST 01h: register/segment-register data path test with 55AAh/AA55h patterns; HLT on failure.

5B5C.name: post_rtc_init
5B5C.comment: CMOS status B := 02h (24h mode), status A := 26h (32 kHz, 976 us), clear C/D; disable MDA/CGA video (3B8h/3D8h := 11h).

5BBC.name: post_02_cmos_shutdown_byte_test
5BBC.comment: POST 02h: walking-bit read/write test of CMOS shutdown byte 0Fh; failure -> fatal 02h.

5BE5.name: post_03_chipset_init
5BE5.comment: POST 03h: chipset regs 6:=CFFFh, 200h:=0, 207h:=0 then ROM-stack call D1F4 with CX=[ACE0].

5C81.name: post_04_timer_init
5C81.comment: POST 04h: PIT ch0 mode 3 count 0 (18.2 Hz tick), ch2 mode 3 count 0533h (speaker tone).

5CB0.name: post_05_dma_test
5CB0.comment: POST 05h: master-clear both 8237s, walking pattern through DMA1 (00h-0Fh) and DMA2 (C0h-DEh) address/count regs; failure -> fatal 05h. Then program DMA modes 40h-43h and cascade C0h.

5D1F.name: post_06_dma_page_test
5D1F.comment: POST 06h: write/verify FFh then 00h in DMA page registers 87,83,81,82,8B,89,8A (table at 5D25); failure -> fatal 06h.

5D67.name: post_08_refresh_test
5D67.comment: POST 08h: verify port 61h bit 4 toggles (DRAM refresh running); failure -> fatal 08h.

5D92.name: post_09_memory_prepare
5D92.comment: POST 09h: speaker/parity off, ROM-stack call sub_D8F6 (memory controller setup), clear parity, zero first 64 KB, check CMOS 34h/58h suspend flags -> 40:B6, else skip test if warm (40:72=1234h).

5D25.name: dma_page_reg_list
5D25.comment: 7 DMA page register port numbers tested by POST 06h.

D8F1.name: post_stub_shl_edx
D8F1.comment: Tail of another routine used as the very first ROM-stack call: EDX <<= 16 then RET (keeps a value handed over from the resume path).

D8F6.name: warm_restore_scratch_edx
D8F6.comment: If KBC system flag (warm reset) is set, load EDX high word from 40:BC (POST scratch preserved across the reset).

D90A.name: warm_check_scratch
D90A.comment: Examines the value restored by warm_restore_scratch_edx (0410h/0420h markers) and dispatches.

C388.name: post_early_pm_init
C388.comment: Clears 40:B5 bits 3/4/7 and ROM-stack calls C4B7 (power-management/chipset early init), then returns.

9BAD.name: chipset_cfg_200_update
9BAD.comment: Reads chipset register 200h (ports 24h/26h); if bit 12 set, reprograms related registers.

7C40.name: hd_init
7C40.comment: POST: read CMOS 0Eh/12h; resolve drive 0/1 types via hd_type_to_param_ptr; save old INT 13h as INT 40h, install int13_hd_handler (INT 13h), int76_hd_irq (INT 76h), INT 41h/46h parameter pointers; 40:74-77; then per drive: AH=10h ready (with tick timeout), 09h init params, 11h recalibrate, 08h params, 04h verify; errors -> 'Fixed disk failure'; update CMOS 0Eh bit 3.

DB2D.name: pit_ch0_init_mode2
DB2D.comment: PIT channel 0 mode 2, count 0 (18.2 Hz system tick).

DBCD.name: chipset_speed_table_program
DBCD.comment: Walk (threshold,value) byte pairs at DC09 to pick a value for chipset register 300h from AL.

DC09.name: cursor_shape_table
DC09.comment: Seven word pairs 2C07h 2407h 2006h 1604h 1203h 0E02h 0002h - cursor start/end per character height (best guess).

9435.name: gate_a20_enable
9435.comment: Enable A20 gate (via KBC output port, or alternate chipset method sub_991D when ROM option AF47 bit7).

944C.name: gate_a20_disable
944C.comment: Disable A20 gate (KBC or alternate sub_992E).

D4B5.name: set_post_error_flag
D4B5.comment: 40:72 bit 0 := 1 (a POST error message was displayed; boot will pause for F1).

D17A.name: beep_hi
D17A.comment: Short beep, PIT ch2 count 04A8h (~1 kHz).

D180.name: beep_lo
D180.comment: Short beep, PIT ch2 count 0951h (~500 Hz).

7A98.name: prompt_f1_continue
7A98.comment: Prints ' Press the F1 key to continue[, F2 to run the setup utility]' (option AF65) then waits.

7B05.name: wait_key_f1_f2
7B05.comment: Waits for F1 (continue) / F2 (enter SETUP via E800:0034 hook) after an error prompt.

8598.name: set_cpu_speed
8598.comment: Selects CPU/clock speed from ROM option bytes AF5D-AF5F (POST codes B0-B3 in sub_9B82).

932A.name: kbd_update_leds
932A.comment: Send LED state (40:17 lock bits) to the keyboard (ED command), guarded by 40:97 bit 6.

AB8E.name: floppy_detect_drives
AB8E.comment: Detects diskette drives / media types; sets 40:90/91 media state used for 40:10 equipment bits.

98B2.name: post_55_cmos_33_check
98B2.comment: POST 55h: compares CMOS 33h low bits with expected byte at 957D.

957D.name: cmos_33_expected
957D.comment: Expected value for CMOS 33h low 3 bits.

98E6.name: post_57_call_miser
98E6.comment: POST 57h: if CMOS 34h bit5 call sub_C451, then far call PhoenixMISER API 10h (E800:0010).

C3C3.name: cmos_diag_status_check
C3C3.comment: Reads CMOS 0Eh via sub_C499 and reacts to bits 6/7 (battery / checksum).

CCD3.name: platform_cfg_from_cmos_3F
CCD3.comment: Copies CMOS 3Fh to I/O port 1FFh and programs chipset registers 9.. from CMOS settings.

D282.name: print_banner
D282.comment: Prints 'PhoenixBIOS(TM) A486 Version 1.03', the copyright line at E020 and the OEM line at B006.

DA02.name: print_cpu_type
DA02.comment: INT 15h AH=C9h (Phoenix: get CPU type) then '<name> processor detected'.

DA4E.name: print_cpu_speed
DA4E.comment: Prints ' operating at NN MHz' unless 40:72 is 123xh (warm).

D46F.name: speaker_toggle
D46F.comment: Toggle port 61h bits 2-3 (speaker gate / parity enable) - used as click during memory test.

D44E.name: parity_check_port61
D44E.comment: Sample port 61h bits 6-7 (I/O channel check / RAM parity error).

774E.name: memtest_64k_block
774E.comment: Walking-one 32-bit data-line test at ES:0000, then fill/verify BP words with FFFFh, then address-line test; CF=1 on failure (AX=bad value).

7722.name: memtest_block_entry
7722.comment: Quick 55AAh/AA55h probe of ES:0000 then memtest_64k_block; SI<0 selects verify mode.

77D1.name: memtest_verify_block
77D1.comment: Verify block previously filled by memtest_64k_block (address pattern), then clear.

781D.name: print_memory_failure
781D.comment: 'Memory failure at SSSS:OOOO, read XXXX expecting YYYY'.

788B.name: print_decimal
788B.comment: Print AX as decimal using divisor table 78B1 (5 digits for extended, 3 for base).

7470.name: memtest_with_display
7470.comment: POST 38h: displays '064K Base Memory, 00000K Extended', runs memtest_run_blocks over base and extended memory, SPACEBAR aborts, updates 40:13 and CMOS 30/31 on failures.

7609.name: memtest_run_blocks
7609.comment: Tests 64 KB blocks BX..CX-1 in protected mode (selector 48h window), updating the on-screen counter.

7296.name: pmode_exit_via_reset
7296.comment: Save SS:SP in 40:67/69, CMOS 0Fh := 08h, jump to 94B0 which resets the CPU (return to real mode on 286-style path).

7325.name: size_extended_memory
7325.comment: Enter protected mode, probe base memory (CMOS 15/16) and extended memory in 64 KB steps up to 64 MB; store 40:13 and CMOS 30/31 (via B0/B1).

73E4.name: memtest_pmode_scan_blocks
73E4.comment: Probe each 64 KB block BX..CX-1 through GDT descriptor 48h (55AAh test) and fill it.

71EB.name: a20_enable_and_enter_pmode
71EB.comment: POST 00h: enable A20 (checks it), build IDT/GDT in low RAM and switch to protected mode; 'Gate A20 failure' on error.

714C.name: pmode_gdt_template_714C
714C.comment: GDT template (descriptors with base 0/A0000h-D8000h, type 93h) used by the protected-mode memory routines.

71D6.name: pmode_unexpected_int
71D6.comment: Handler for every IDT entry in protected mode: POST code 90h, IRET (detected by shutdown_08 path).

8A09.name: serial_port_init
8A09.comment: Init UART at DX (LCR 3xFBh): 8N1, then detect via scratch/loopback.

D47E.name: parallel_port_detect
D47E.comment: Write 0Bh to data port DX, verify readback (printer port presence).

6EBE.name: scan_option_roms
6EBE.comment: Scan SI..CX (segments) in 2 KB steps for 55AAh; check size/checksum (sub_D1FB); far call init at +3 through 40:67; 'BIOS ROM bad checksum = XXXXh' on error. DL bit0 => print_crlf afterwards.

D1FB.name: rom_checksum
D1FB.comment: Sum CX bytes at DS:0; ZF=1 if 8-bit sum is zero.

6F4F.name: pic_mask_reg_test
6F4F.comment: Walking-bit write/read test of the PIC mask register at DX.

6F73.name: dma_regs_walking_test
6F73.comment: Walking-bit test of DMA address/count registers starting at DX (CX regs, step SI).

6FD1.name: video_vsync_check
6FD1.comment: Wait for vertical-retrace bit toggle on CRTC status port (40:63 + 6).

7013.name: video_ram_test_and_mode
7013.comment: POST 2Bh: test video RAM at B000h/B800h (memtest_64k_block), POST 2Ch set mode, POST 2Dh vsync check; final POST 30h+adapter type.

6D3A.name: detect_equipment
6D3A.comment: Probe serial ports (table 6D24), parallel ports, game port 201h and hard-disk controller; fill 40:10 equipment word.

6DBA.name: probe_serial_port
6DBA.comment: Write scratch register (DX+7) pattern 55h/AAh and read back; ZF=1 if UART present.

6E1A.name: probe_parallel_port
6E1A.comment: Write 5Ah to data port and read back.

6DF7.name: probe_game_port
6DF7.comment: Trigger 201h and time the monostable bits.

6E2C.name: probe_hd_controller
6E2C.comment: Reset via 3F6h bit2, then read 1F7h status: FFh means no controller.

6E59.name: superio_init_26E
6E59.comment: Program Super I/O configuration at index/data 26Eh/26Fh (reg 00:=4F?, 01:=10, 03:=00) then continue at 5B16.

5B0D.name: post_after_memsize
5B0D.comment: Shutdown code 1 / warm re-entry: port 61h:=0Ch then Super I/O init, then POST 01h.

5E65.name: post_0D_ram_stack
5E65.comment: Real stack now at 0000:8000. POST 0Dh parity check, warm flag restore, BDA keyboard buffer init, equipment detection, serial/parallel init. 40:B6 bit0 (quick boot) skips the slow tests.

5FB0.name: post_25_init_ivt
5FB0.comment: POST 25h: all 256 vectors -> int_default_handler (offset stepped by -10h per vector when ROM option AF45 bit5), INT 60-67 zeroed, then tables ivt_init_08_1F / ivt_init_70_77, INT 02h and INT 05h; PIC1 mask FAh.

603F.name: post_27_kbc_selftest
603F.comment: POST 27h: KBC self test (AAh->55h) with 5 retries, command byte 7Ch, read input port -> 40:12.

60A2.name: post_28_cmos_checksum
60A2.comment: POST 28h: CMOS 0Dh/0Eh status, checksum 10h-2Dh vs 2Eh/2Fh; update CMOS 0Eh.

610E.name: post_29_video_config
610E.comment: POST 29h: reconcile CMOS 14h display bits with 40:10 equipment word and ROM options (LCD/CRT).

61BD.name: post_2C_video_init
61BD.comment: POST 2Ch: INT 10h mode 0 (mono) then mode 3, video RAM test; 'Display adapter failed; using alternate'.

6285.name: post_2E_option_rom_c000
6285.comment: POST 2Eh: sub_9835 (POST 53h), option ROM scan C000-C800 (or direct far call E000:0003 for the on-board VGA ROM), CCD3, banner, CPU type/speed.

6305.name: post_34_timer_tick_test
6305.comment: POST 34h: hook INT 08h, wait for a tick; 'No timer tick interrupt'.

636D.name: post_35_shutdown_test
636D.comment: POST 35h: A20 float test at 0:500 / FFFF:510, then KBC pulse-reset (FEh) with CMOS 0Fh=0Ah; 'Shutdown failure' if the timer fires instead.

6478.name: post_after_shutdown_test
6478.comment: Manufacturing mode (40:12 bit5) forces base memory 100h/200h KB else size_extended_memory.

64A9.name: post_3A_timer2_test
64A9.comment: Set CR0.ET from CMOS 33h bit4; POST 3Ah: PIT ch2 counting test; 'Timer 2 failure'.

6527.name: post_keyboard_test
6527.comment: Clear 40:17-19/71/96/97; KBC/keyboard reset sequence with error strings 'Keyboard controller/clock line/data line/stuck key failure', 'Pointer device failure'; CMOS 59h bit5 -> mouse present (40:10 bit2).

6859.name: post_38_memory_test
6859.comment: POST 38h: memtest_with_display, then keyboard ID (F2h), enhanced-keyboard detection.

6912.name: post_3B_rtc_test
6912.comment: POST 3Bh: wait for CMOS 0Ch update-ended flag (UIP via 0Ah); 'Real time clock failure' sets CMOS 0Eh bit2.

69AC.name: fpu_detect
69AC.comment: FNINIT / FNSTCW=03FFh / FNSTSW=0 => 40:10 bit1, unmask IRQ13.

6A0E.name: post_56_cmos_memsize_check
6A0E.comment: POST 56h: CMOS 15/16 base and 17/18 vs 30/31 extended sizes against 40:13; mismatch -> POST 59h, CMOS 0Eh bit4.

6AA4.name: ebda_setup
6AA4.comment: Reserve 1 KB EBDA at top of base memory: 40:13 -= 1, 40:0E = seg, EBDA[0]=1. Then KBC output port tweaks (DDh).

6AEF.name: floppy_hd_reset_detect
6AEF.comment: Reset HD controller (3F6h bit2), floppy_detect_drives, set 40:10 floppy bits.

6B33.name: post_57_option_rom_c800
6B33.comment: chipset_cfg_200_update, cmos_hd_type_check, CMOS diag check, POST 57h MISER call, option ROM scan C800-E000, 'Time-of-day not set - run SETUP program'.

6B96.name: keyboard_lock_check
6B96.comment: KBC command byte 65h; status bit4 => 'Keyboard is locked - unlock'.

6C03.name: config_error_check
6C03.comment: 40:72 bit0 => 'Invalid configuration information - please run SETUP program' + F1/F2 prompt, else beep.

6C56.name: post_prepare_boot
6C56.comment: 40:72:=0, print 'Press [Ctrl]+[Alt]+[S] to enter SETUP', optional INT 10h mode set, clear IDT area, re-enable NMI, stack 0030:0100, fall into boot_start.

6CF9.name: apply_cpu_speed_from_cmos
6CF9.comment: CMOS 34h bits 0-1 select one of three speed bytes AF5D/5E/5F -> set_cpu_speed.

D56F.name: int_default_handler
D56F.comment: Default handler installed in every IVT slot by POST 25h ('Unexpected interrupt' reporting).

94E9.name: chipset_init_table_94E9
94E9.comment: (index, value) word pairs for the PicoPower chipset written at POST.

95C4.name: post_50_chipset_table
95C4.comment: POST 50h: warm (40:72=1234h) -> post_after_memsize; else program chipset from chipset_init_table.

9688.name: post_52_a20_and_pmode_memsize
9688.comment: POST 52h: flush KBC, set output-port bit1 (A20), refresh timer, LGDT gdt_memsize, CR0.PE, far jump 0010:97C2 (32-bit DRAM sizing).

97C2.name: pmode_dram_sizing
97C2.comment: Runs with CS selector 0010h: writes 55555555h patterns through a flat data selector to find installed DRAM bank sizes, then returns to real mode at 97F4.

97F4.name: dram_bank_program
97F4.comment: Real mode again: program chipset DRAM bank registers (table 9831) from the sizes found, then jump post_after_memsize.

ACD3.name: rom_checksum_params
ACD3.comment: ACD3: E020 (copyright start), ACD7: 02A3 (length), ACD9: E840 (extra byte); ACE0: F580 (segment), ACE2: A800 (length) => POST 03h ROM checksum covers F000:5800-FFFF (sum is 00).

AF65.name: setup_hotkey_scancode
AF65.comment: 1Fh = make code of 'S': SETUP hot key is Ctrl+Alt+S. Zero would disable the hot key and the F2 prompt text.

AF68.name: rom_option_extra_com
AF68.comment: Two extra serial port bases (AF68, AF6A) or 0.

70B4.name: time_constants
70B4.comment: 0Ah, 3Ch, 00DCh, 1234h - BCD/time conversion constants used by INT 1Ah time validation (70BB).

70BB.name: validate_rtc_time
70BB.comment: INT 1Ah AH=2 and range-check hours/minutes/seconds; convert to ticks into 40:6C/6E; CF=1 if valid.

5B16.name: post_kbc_sysflag_cmos_b3
5B16.comment: If KBC system flag clear, record CR0 bit0 into CMOS 33h bit4; then POST 01h.

78DF.name: int19_boot
78DF.comment: INT 19h body: INT 1Eh := diskette_param_table, INT 13h reset, up to 3 floppy reads of sector 1 to 0000:7C00, else hard disk (if 40:75 drives and CMOS 0Eh bit3 clear); validate boot sector then jump.

79AC.name: msg_boot_failures
79AC.comment: Boot failure messages: diskette read failure / not a boot diskette / no boot device / hard disk read failure / no boot sector.

7A36.name: int18_boot_fail
7A36.comment: INT 18h: prints ' press F1 to retry boot[, F2 for setup utility]' and waits (wait_key_f1_f2).

BC63.name: int15_handler
BC63.comment: INT 15h body (F859 jumps here). Compare chain: 87h move block, 53h -> MISER APM (E800:0028), BCh, 91h, C0h sysconfig, C2h pointing device (table C766), C1h EBDA segment, 4Fh keyboard intercept, 5Fh platform video (AL=31h/33h/35h), C9h CPU type, then table int15_80_91_dispatch.

BCD6.name: int15_5F_platform_video
BCD6.comment: Phoenix/C&T platform hooks: AL=35h (read CMOS display settings -> chipset), 31h, 33h (BL=30h/32h). The VGA ROM calls AX=5F34h which falls through as unsupported.

C030.name: int15_4F_kbd_intercept
C030.comment: INT 15h AH=4Fh keyboard intercept (called by INT 09h for every scancode in AL). First hotkey_dispatch (Ctrl+Alt+F3/F4/F8 and Fn codes 65h/66h/6Ah), then with Ctrl+Alt held (40:17 bits 2,3) and AL not a Ctrl/Alt make/break code, int15_4F_setup_hotkey_check. CF=1 means 'pass the key on'.

D93E.name: int15_C9_get_cpu_type
D93E.comment: Phoenix extension: CPU type/name index (names at D94F).

D94F.name: cpu_name_table
D94F.comment: '486 DX','486 SX','486 DX2','486 DX4','386 DX','386 SX','386 SL','Cyrix 486 DX','Cyrix 486 SX' NUL-separated.

BDB0.name: int15_87_move_block_body
BDB0.comment: INT 15h AH=87h: enable A20, save SS:SP in 40:67/69, build GDT entries in the caller's descriptor table (ES:SI): BIOS code 24h (base F0000, 9Bh), stack 2Ch (SS, 93h), load GDT, IDT from C209, CR0.PE, far jump 0020h; copy CX words with movsd (aligned, 486-friendly) from selector 10h to 18h; check port 61h parity bits; CR0.PE off, far jump back, reload real-mode GDT copy at BEE0; restore and return AH=0 (or 02h parity / 03h A20 error).

9835.name: post_53_platform_init
9835.comment: POST 53h: CMOS 34h/3Fh derived platform setup (port 1FFh, shadow options) before option ROM scan (best guess).

CE19.name: fm_synth_all_notes_off
CE19.comment: Writes 0 to OPL2/AdLib registers B0h-B8h through 388h/389h (key-off for all 9 FM channels) - silences the on-board FM sound chip during POST. Called before option ROM scan and from platform_cfg_from_cmos_3F.

CDF6.name: superio_read_reg
CDF6.comment: AL=index -> port 26Eh, returns AL from 26Fh (Super I/O configuration read).

CE07.name: superio_write_reg
CE07.comment: AL=index, AH=value -> Super I/O configuration ports 26Eh/26Fh.

CD2C.name: superio_configure_from_cmos
CD2C.comment: Programs the Super I/O (COM/LPT/VersaPort mode, floppy) from CMOS 10h/59h settings using superio_read_reg/superio_write_reg.

7ED5.name: int13h_status_epilogue_table
7ED5.comment: 22 near pointers indexed by AH (function) used by the exit path to adjust AL/CF conventions (e.g. reset returns AL=50h on error).

7E72.name: int13h_dispatch
7E72.comment: 22 near pointers indexed by AH (00h-15h): the real hard-disk INT 13h function table (installed handler int13_hd_handler).

7DFE.name: int13_hd_handler
7DFE.comment: INT 13h vector after hd_init: DL < 80h -> INT 40h (floppy, original vector); AH=0 with DL >= 82h -> ok; AH=1 -> AL = 40:74 status; else int13_hd_body.

7E39.name: int13_hd_body
7E39.comment: pusha/es/flags, DL -= 80h, DS=0, 40:74 := 0, AH >= 16h -> unsupported; unmask IRQ14/IRQ2, BP = AH*2, drive check against 40:75, jmp int13h_dispatch[AH].

7DDE.name: int76_hd_irq
7DDE.comment: IRQ14 handler installed by hd_init: 40:8E := FFh (operation complete), EOI both PICs, INT 15h AX=9100h (interrupt complete), IRET.

7B5E.name: hd_type_to_param_ptr
7B5E.comment: AL = CMOS 12h nibble, AH = CMOS index (99h/9Ah) of the extended type byte. 0 -> none; 1-2Fh -> ES:SI = hd_param_table + (type-1)*16; 30h/31h -> user-defined table copied from CMOS into 40:C0 / 40:D0 (hd_user_params_from_cmos); else 'Fixed disk configuration error'.

7BDA.name: hd_user_params_from_cmos
7BDA.comment: Build a 16-byte drive parameter block at 40:C0 (type 30h, CMOS 20h-2Fh) or 40:D0 (type 31h, CMOS 35h-..) from CMOS bytes: cyl, heads, wpcomp, control (8 if heads > 8), landing zone, sectors.

7D9E.name: print_fixed_disk_failure
7D9E.comment: 'Fixed disk failure' (same text for drive 0 and 1).

9C03.name: hd_autodetect_patch_table
9C03.comment: Runs from the shadow-RAM copy: if the 4 spare entries (types 44-47, E6B1-E6F0) are still zero, fill them from CMOS types 19h/1Ah via hd_autodetect_fill_entry and adjust the ROM checksum byte at F000:FFEF by the bytes written.

9C4D.name: hd_autodetect_fill_entry
9C4D.comment: AL = CMOS extended type: <= 2Dh (44/45 = Auto Detected / AUTO 2) -> ata_identify_to_table; 2Eh/2Fh (User Defined / USER 2) -> copy CMOS A0h../B5h.. parameters into table entries 46/47 (E6D1/E6E1).

9CBC.name: cmos_read_bl_stosb_sum
9CBC.comment: AL = CMOS[BL++|80h] -> ES:DI, CL += AL (checksum accumulation).

9CCF.name: cmos_read_ext_type
9CCF.comment: Read CMOS byte AL; returns it in AL (2Ch-2Fh = auto/user types).

9CE9.name: ata_identify_to_table
9CE9.comment: ATA IDENTIFY DEVICE: wait DRDY (1F7h bit 6) and !BSY, 3F6h := 02h (nIEN), zero 1F1h-1F5h, 1F6h := drive<<4 (no LBA bit), 1F7h := ECh, read 256 words into a 512-byte stack buffer, then write cylinders (word 1), heads (word 3), sectors (word 6) into hd_param_table entry (AL-1), landing zone = cylinders, control byte = 8 if heads > 8; returns CL = byte sum for the checksum fix.

9D9F.name: hd_spare_entries_zero_check
9D9F.comment: ZF=1 if the 64 bytes at E6B1 (table entries 44-47) are zero.

9DAB.name: ata_wait_drdy
9DAB.comment: Poll 1F7h bit 6 (DRDY) up to 3*65535*100 refresh cycles; CF=1 AL=50h on timeout.

9DD5.name: ata_wait_not_busy
9DD5.comment: Poll 1F7h bit 7 (BSY) clear; CF=1 AL=51h on timeout.

9DFF.name: ata_wait_drq
9DFF.comment: Poll 1F7h bit 3 (DRQ); CF=1 AL=52h on timeout.

9E36.name: chipset_reg_write
9E36.comment: AX = index, DX = value -> chipset register.

E6B1.name: hd_param_table_spare_44_47
E6B1.comment: Table entries for types 44-47 (Auto Detected, AUTO 2, User Defined, USER 2); zero in ROM, filled at run time in the shadow copy.

FFEF.name: rom_checksum_adjust_byte
FFEF.comment: Byte adjusted by hd_autodetect_patch_table so that the shadow copy of F000 keeps its 8-bit checksum after the disk table is patched.

8255.name: hd_get_param_ptr
8255.comment: DL = drive 0/1 -> ES:SI = drive parameter table through the INT 41h (0:0104) / INT 46h (0:0118) vectors (DL*14h + 104h).

8266.name: hd_normalize_buffer
8266.comment: Normalise ES:BX to ES:DI (DI < 16); check that AL sectors x 512 (516 for read/write long, BP bit 4) do not cross a 64 KB boundary, else AH = 09h.

831B.name: hd_build_task_file
831B.comment: Fill the task-file image at 40:41-48 from INT 13h registers: 442 precomp (table wpcomp/4), 443 sector count (AL), 444 sector (CL & 3Fh), 445/446 cylinder (CH + CL bits 6-7, plus DH bits 5-7 as cylinder bits 10-12 - Phoenix large-disk extension), 447 drive/head (A0h | DL<<4 | head & 7/0Fh), 448 command (AH); 40:76 = control byte; AH=1/CF if DL >= 40:75.

8383.name: hd_issue_command
8383.comment: 40:8E := 0, 3F6h := control byte, wait !BSY (hd_wait_not_busy_long), write 1F1h-1F6h from 40:442-447, write command 448 to 1F7h if non-zero, then hd_wait_drdy_alt.

8298.name: hd_wait_irq
8298.comment: Wait for int76_hd_irq to set 40:8E = FFh: INT 15h AX=9000h (device busy) then a 40:BE x 65536 poll; on timeout 3F6h := 04h (soft reset) and AH = 80h (CF from INT 15h).

82CF.name: hd_wait_irq_altstatus
82CF.comment: Variant of hd_wait_irq that also polls the alternate status register 3F6h for DRQ (unreferenced by static analysis).

8458.name: hd_check_status
8458.comment: Read 1F7h status (40:8C) and 1F1h error (40:8D); map to INT 13h codes: 0Ah bad block, 04h sector not found, 02h address mark, 10h ECC, 05h reset, BBh undefined, CCh write fault, AAh not ready, 40h seek, 11h corrected ECC.

83B4.name: hd_next_sector_check
83B4.comment: Multi-sector loop: BH = sectors remaining; re-read status when the command stalls; AH=20h controller error.

83E9.name: hd_wait_not_busy_long
83E9.comment: Poll 1F7h BSY clear up to 60000 x 100 refresh cycles; AH=20h/CF on timeout.

8404.name: hd_wait_drq
8404.comment: Poll 1F7h DRQ (bit 3) up to 1500h loops, then hd_check_status; AH=20h/CF.

842A.name: hd_wait_drq_read
842A.comment: Like hd_wait_drq but on error drains one sector from 1F0h into ES:DI.

8571.name: hd_wait_drdy_alt
8571.comment: Poll alternate status 3F6h until (BSY,DRDY) = (0,1); 3 x 30000 loops; CF on timeout.

84F8.name: hd_wait_ready_60s
84F8.comment: POST: up to 60 x 1 s waiting for 1F7h (BSY,DRDY) = (0,1) using wait_refresh_cycles with callback 84ED.

84ED.name: hd_ready_check
84ED.comment: push dx; 1F7h status & C0h == 40h (DRDY without BSY); pop dx.

8503.name: hd_idle_immediate_pm
8503.comment: Power-management path: wait DRDY, chipset register 0 manipulation (24h/26h), 1F7h := E1h (IDLE IMMEDIATE), wait for DRDY on 3F6h, restore chipset register (unreferenced statically; best guess called by MISER).

7EA0.name: hd_exit
7EA0.comment: Common INT 13h HD exit: STI, 40:74 := AH (if not already set), pop flags/ES/regs, then int13h_status_epilogue_entry.

7F63.name: hd_15_get_type
7F63.comment: AH=15h: AH=03h (fixed disk), CX:DX = (cylinders-1) x heads x sectors.

7F9A.name: hd_00_reset
7F9A.comment: AH=00h: INT 40h reset floppy first, then 3F6h := 04h/00h pulse, and for each drive AH=09h init + AH=11h recalibrate through int13_hd_handler.

7FEC.name: hd_02_read_sectors
7FEC.comment: AH=02h: command 20h (0Ah: 22h read long). hd_normalize_buffer, hd_build_task_file, hd_issue_command, then per sector: hd_wait_irq, hd_wait_drq_read, `rep insw` 256 words (+4/+3 ECC bytes for read long), hd_next_sector_check.

8067.name: hd_03_write_sectors
8067.comment: AH=03h: command 30h (0Bh: 32h write long); waits DRQ then `rep outsw` 256 words per sector, ECC bytes for long, hd_wait_irq, hd_check_status.

8119.name: hd_05_format_track
8119.comment: AH=05h: command 50h with sector count = spt, writes the 512-byte interleave table from ES:BX.

815B.name: hd_08_get_params
815B.comment: AH=08h: DH = heads-1, DL = 40:75 drive count, CH/CL = (cylinders-2) packed with spt; DL >= 2 -> AH=07h.

81A4.name: hd_09_init_params
81A4.comment: AH=09h: INITIALIZE DEVICE PARAMETERS (91h) with heads-1 and spt from the table.

81FD.name: hd_10_test_ready
81FD.comment: AH=10h: command 00h (NOP style ready check via task file only).

8212.name: hd_14_diagnostics
8212.comment: AH=14h: EXECUTE DEVICE DIAGNOSTIC (90h); error register 1F1h == 01h means pass.

7F9F.name: hd_0D_reset_alt
7F9F.comment: AH=0Dh: same as reset without the floppy part.

5C30.name: post_copyright_integrity_check
5C30.comment: After POST 03h checksum (result ignored by `jz $+4`): sums 2A3h bytes of the copyright text at E020 (params ACD3/ACD7) mixed with the byte at E840 (ACD9); if the result is not zero the code spins in an obfuscated loop (5C6B) forever. Anti-tamper - do not modify E020-E2C2 or E840 when patching.

E840.name: copyright_check_extra_byte
E840.comment: Extra byte included in the anti-tamper copyright checksum (see 5C30).

D1F4.name: rom_checksum_core
D1F4.comment: DS := [ACE0] = F580h, CX := [ACE2] = A800h, then rom_checksum: 8-bit sum of F000:5800-FFFF must be zero.

8695.name: int15_4F_setup_hotkey_check
8695.comment: If setup_hotkey_scancode (AF65) is non-zero, AL equals it (1Fh = 'S', so Ctrl+Alt+S) and SETUP is not active (40:B5 bit0): sub_931D (EOI), clear 40:96 bit1, far call MISER API 34h (F000:86D1 -> E800:0034) which launches SETUP; returns CF=0 (key consumed).

86D1.name: miser_api34_farptr
86D1.comment: Far pointer E800:0034 used by the hot-key path.

CAD5.name: hotkey_dispatch
CAD5.comment: Notebook hot keys inside the INT 15h 4Fh intercept: raw scancodes 65h/66h/6Ah (Fn-key combinations from the keyboard controller) or, with Ctrl+Alt held, F3 (3Dh) / F4 (3Eh) / F8 (42h): -> hotkey_setup / hotkey_display_toggle / hotkey_power_meter. Other keys return to the caller.

CB2C.name: hotkey_setup
CB2C.comment: Ctrl+Alt+F3 / Fn code 65h: if MISER present and SETUP not active, set 40:B6 bit1, flush keyboard buffer, clear Ctrl/Alt state, far call MISER API 34h (SETUP), then clear the flag.

CB84.name: hotkey_display_toggle
CB84.comment: Ctrl+Alt+F4 / Fn code 66h: chipset reg 9 bit 9 := 0, INT 10h AX=5F50h (panel info), choose next device (DL bit3 -> CRT=0, DL bit1 -> both=2, else LCD=1), INT 10h AX=5F51h BL=device, delay, chipset reg 9 bit 9 := 1.

CBE3.name: hotkey_power_meter
CBE3.comment: Ctrl+Alt+F8 / Fn code 6Ah: if MISER present and 40:B6 bit2 allows, unmask IRQ1, enable keyboard (AEh), EOI, pre hook, far call MISER API 30h (show_power_meter), post hook.

CB18.name: hotkey_exit_consumed
CB18.comment: Unmask IRQ1 and return CF=0 (key consumed) from the intercept.

CC33.name: miser_present_check
CC33.comment: If SETUP is not active, far call MISER API 38h; ZF result used by the hot-key handlers.

CC5E.name: power_meter_allowed_check
CC5E.comment: Tests 40:B6 bit 2 (best guess: power-meter display permitted / battery system present).

CCA3.name: chipset_reg_read_bx
CCA3.comment: AX = index -> BX = chipset register value (ports 24h/26h).

CCAE.name: chipset_reg_write_bx
CCAE.comment: AX = index, BX = value -> chipset register.

03CC.name: setup_page_field_counts
03CC.comment: Per page: index of the last field record (13h = 20 fields on page 1, 05h = 6 fields on page 2).

03CE.name: setup_page_word_table_a
03CE.comment: Per page word ([bp+2C]): 00E5h / 00F9h (stack-frame offsets, best guess: key/handler list).

03D2.name: setup_page_field_records
03D2.comment: Per page pointer to the 32-byte field record array ([bp+26]): page 1 -> 014Ch, page 2 -> 1874h.

03D6.name: setup_page_descriptors
03D6.comment: Two 14-byte page descriptors: title (row/col, string), label block (count, string, row/col), second block; selected by setup_select_page.

014C.name: setup_fields_page1
014C.comment: 20 x 32-byte field records for Basic Setup: +0 row, +1 col, +2 value string, +4/+6/+8/+C/+E/+10/+12 handlers (draw, edit, key, validate, CMOS read/write), +A common handler, +14 CMOS index (low) and bit mask (high), +16 range/option count, +18 option width/format, +1A/+1C/+1D secondary label handler and position, +1E value type (11h/12h = string lives in the stack frame), +1F field kind (66h = option list, 22h = disk type list, 00 = numeric).

1874.name: setup_fields_page2
1874.comment: 6 x 32-byte field records for Power & Video Setup (same layout as setup_fields_page1).

21A8.name: setup_print_at
21A8.comment: ES:SI = NUL-terminated string, DX = row/col, BL = attribute ([bp+17]): INT 10h 13h; returns CX = length.

233F.name: setup_field_pos_and_value
233F.comment: DH/DL = record row/col, SI = record value-string pointer.

2621.name: setup_select_page
2621.comment: Loads the per-page tables for page [bp+25]: count (03CC), word (03CE), record array (03D2), descriptor (03D6).

292E.name: setup_draw_title
292E.comment: Print the page title from the page descriptor.

293D.name: setup_draw_labels
293D.comment: Print the left and right string blocks of the page descriptor, one line per string; page 1 adds the 'Cylinders/Heads/Sectors' footer at 0A47.

28F5.name: setup_draw_page_number
28F5.comment: 'Page   of  ' with current page+1 and total 2.

28CE.name: setup_draw_page
28CE.comment: Clear, title, labels, then all field values (setup_draw_fields).

298D.name: setup_draw_fields
298D.comment: For every field record: value via handler +6 (or list formatter 2301 for kind 66h), secondary label via +1A.

2223.name: setup_draw_field
2223.comment: Draw one field record (index [bp+2B]); memory-size rows on page 1 use setup_draw_memory (3B4D).

3B4D.name: setup_draw_time_date
3B4D.comment: Page 0 rows 0-5: prints hh:mm:ss (rtc_read_time) and the date as month name (3-letter table 0C32h), day and 4-digit year (rtc_read_date) with the current field highlighted (field_pos_attr_for_index).

38B0.name: setup_ext_checksum_to_shadow
38B0.comment: Recomputes the Phoenix extended checksum over 40h-7Dh into shadow 7Eh/7Fh.

3894.name: setup_cmos_write_field
3894.comment: Recomputes the standard CMOS checksum over 10h-2Dh (cmos_std_checksum_calc) into shadow 2Eh/2Fh.

2363.name: setup_key_default
2363.comment: Default key handler placeholder for field records.

1FBE.name: setup_field_common
1FBE.comment: Common per-field handler referenced by every record at +0Ah.

2A8F.name: setup_nop_handler
2A8F.comment: Empty handler (RET) used to fill unused record slots.

2AAC.name: list_field_load_from_cmos
2AAC.comment: Edit handler for option-list fields (kind 66h): cycles the CMOS bits through the option strings.

A10B.name: int13_floppy_entry
A10B.comment: INT 13h diskette body (EC59 jumps here; INT 40h after hd_init). Saves registers with BP frame ([bp+2] = current diskette parameter table pointer), optional CPU speed switch (ROM option AF46 bit0/AF55 bit1: run the FDC at the speed byte AF59), AH >= 21h or DL >= 2 -> unsupported, then int13_floppy_dispatch[AH].

A0BA.name: floppy_speed_switch_needed
A0BA.comment: ZF from ROM options AF46 bit0 and AF55 bit1: whether diskette I/O must run at a fixed CPU speed (set_cpu_speed with AF59).

9F1A.name: get_diskette_param_table
9F1A.comment: ES:SI = INT 1Eh vector (0000:0078) - the active diskette parameter table.

9E9A.name: diskette_param_tables
9E9A.comment: Built-in diskette parameter tables, 8 tables of 14 bytes (standard 11-byte DPT + max track, data rate, type): 9E9A 360K, 9EA8 360K in 1.2M drive, 9EB6 1.2M, 9EC4/9ED2 720K, 9EE0 1.44M, 9EEE 720K in 2.88M drive, 9EFC 1.44M in 2.88M drive; [bp+2] points at the one in use; A7D5/A8DE index them as (ptr-9E9Ah)/14.

A7D5.name: floppy_select_media_params
A7D5.comment: Pick the parameter table / data-rate for the drive from 40:90/91 media-state bits (tables at A7AF and A7B7), store the pointer in [bp+2].

9F68.name: floppy_motor_on
9F68.comment: Turn the drive motor on via the digital output register (3F2h), track motor state in 40:3F/40:40 with the spin-up delay from the parameter table.

AB17.name: floppy_media_check
AB17.comment: Check the change line (3F7h bit 7) and media state; CF = media changed / not ready.

A02F.name: floppy_dma_setup
A02F.comment: Program DMA channel 2: mode 46h read / 4Ah write / 42h verify (mode reg 0Bh), address/page (04h/05h/81h) from ES:BX, count from sectors x sector size; AH=09h if the transfer would cross a 64 KB boundary.

A811.name: floppy_seek
A811.comment: Seek to the requested cylinder (recalibrate first when the media state says the drive is uncalibrated); updates 40:94/95 current cylinder.

A52A.name: floppy_wait_head_settle
A52A.comment: Head settle delay from the parameter table (doubled for the 9EA8 table).

A253.name: fdc_write_byte
A253.comment: Write AL to the FDC data register 3F5h after waiting for RQM with DIO=0 (sub_A19F); on protocol error reads back results, 40:441 := 20h (controller failure), CF=1.

A251.name: fdc_write_byte_cf
A251.comment: Entry into fdc_write_byte that first tests CF from the previous write.

A27F.name: fdc_write_head_drive
A27F.comment: Write the head/drive byte (head<<2 | drive) to the FDC.

AA57.name: floppy_wait_irq
AA57.comment: Unmask IRQ6, INT 15h AX=9001h (device busy), wait for 40:3E bit 7 (set by the IRQ6 handler) with a 15 x 1M refresh-cycle timeout (callback AA4F); CF = timeout.

A223.name: fdc_read_results_check
A223.comment: Read the 7 result bytes into 40:42-48 (sub_A1DD) and translate ST0/ST1 into the INT 13h status (40:441): 20h controller, 08h DMA overrun, 04h sector not found, 03h write protect, 02h address mark, 10h CRC.

A1DD.name: fdc_read_result_bytes
A1DD.comment: Read result phase bytes from 3F5h into 40:42.. until the FDC drops RQM/DIO.

A19F.name: fdc_wait_rqm
A19F.comment: Wait for the main status register 3F4h to show RQM; AL = MSR; CF on timeout.

A351.name: floppy_reset_controller
A351.comment: AH=00h: clear 40:3E/41, DOR reset pulse (3F2h), wait IRQ, 4 x sense-interrupt (sub_A28A), then Specify from the parameter table.

A3A3.name: floppy_last_sector
A3A3.comment: AL = sectors per track: max of the INT 1Eh table byte +4 and the internal table byte +4.

A67C.name: floppy_media_state_update
A67C.comment: After a successful read, set 40:90/91 media-state bits (data rate, established) for the drive.

A8DE.name: floppy_set_media_state_from_table
A8DE.comment: 40:90/91 := media state code for the parameter table selected in [bp+2] (table A8D4).

A661.name: floppy_drive_type_known
A661.comment: ZF from 40:90/91 for drive BL: media type already established.

A627.name: floppy_get_drive_type
A627.comment: AL = CMOS 10h drive type nibble for the drive.

A3B8.name: int13f_02_03_04_read_write_verify
A3B8.comment: AH=02h/03h/04h: select params, motor on, media check, DMA setup, seek, head settle, then FDC command 66h (read data MFM+skip) / 45h (write data MFM) / 66h verify with C/H/R/N/EOT/GPL/DTL from the parameter table; wait IRQ, read results; on media-change or data-rate mismatch (40:441 = 02/04/10 with media state bit 4 clear) retry with the next data rate (sub_9FC6). Returns AL = sectors transferred.

8CC0.name: int09_kbd_irq_body
8CC0.comment: INT 09h body (E987 jumps here): disable keyboard (ADh), read scancode from 60h, STI, INT 15h AH=4Fh intercept (CF=0 means the key was consumed - hot keys, MISER), then look the scancode up in kbd_special_scancodes and dispatch through kbd_special_dispatch with CL = shift mask, CH = 40:96 flags; normal keys go to kbd_normal_key.

8D1F.name: kbd_normal_key
8D1F.comment: Ordinary make code: ignore break codes (bit 7), handle Ctrl+Alt+Del (scancode 53h with Ctrl+Alt: 40:72 := 1234h, A20 on, KBC pulse reset FEh, HLT), numeric keypad 47h-53h with Alt (Alt-numpad accumulator 40:19 via table 92B8), Num Lock / Shift keypad tables (9310, 9260, 9208, 91B0), otherwise translate through the base tables and store in the buffer.

8D40.name: kbd_ctrl_alt_del
8D40.comment: Ctrl+Alt+Del: warm-boot flag 40:72 := 1234h, enable A20 if protected mode is on (SMSW bit 0), KBC command FEh (pulse reset line), HLT.

9387.name: kbd_translate_lookup
9387.comment: Look up scancode AL in the translation table at CS:DI (scancode, ASCII pairs); returns AL = character, CF/ZF for not found.

8EB7.name: kbd_store_key
8EB7.comment: Store AX (scan/ASCII) into the keyboard buffer 40:1A/1C with wraparound and overflow beep.

8F19.name: int09_exit
8F19.comment: Re-enable keyboard (AEh), EOI, pop registers, IRET.

D356.name: int02_nmi_handler
D356.comment: NMI: bump the POST code on port 80h, read port 61h (bit 7 RAM parity, bit 6 I/O channel check), disable both checks (61h |= 0Ch). With ROM option AF45 bit5 also check PIC2 ISR (0Bh) for an unexpected IRQ. Prints 'Memory parity' / 'I/O card parity' / 'Unexpected type 02' + ' interrupt at CS:IP', then 'Type (S)hut off NMI, (R)eboot': R -> post_entry, S -> leave the checks disabled and IRET.

D340.name: wait_key_from_list
D340.comment: Wait for a key whose uppercase letter is in the list at CS:SI (D7D1 = 'RS'); AL = letter.

BF40.name: int15_89_enter_pmode_body
BF40.comment: INT 15h AH=89h: program the KBC output port (D1h) with DFh (A20 on) or DDh, wait for input-buffer empty at each step, pulse FFh (NOP); then load the caller's GDT/IDT (ES:SI), set CR0.PE and far jump to the caller's code selector with BH/BL interrupt bases programmed into the PICs.

C209.name: pmode_idt_gdt_C209
C209.comment: IDT pseudo-descriptor (limit 0100h, base C211h) followed by the GDT used by the INT 15h block-move / memory sizing code (descriptors with type 93h/87h).

BEE0.name: gdt_realmode_pseudo_descriptor
BEE0.comment: Pseudo-descriptor (limit FFFF, base 0) reloaded after leaving protected mode.

C4F4.name: cpu_tlb_test
C4F4.comment: 486 TLB test through test registers TR6/TR7 (mov tr6/tr7 are shown as data bytes 0F 26 xx): writes linear/physical patterns 01234567h/89ABCDEFh/00112233h/44556677h and reads them back; code islands at E740/E750 are part of it.

1C67.name: setup_load_cmos_flags
1C67.comment: AL=0Eh: read CMOS diagnostic byte and derive the correction flags in [bp+2F].

E3FE.name: int13_fixed_entry
E3FE.comment: Classic IBM entry point F000:E3FE: jmp int13_hd_handler. PhoenixMISER's std_disk_setup points INT 13h here directly.

EF5A.name: int0E_fixed_entry_miser
EF5A.comment: Classic IBM INT 0Eh (diskette IRQ) entry area F000:EF57..: here a far jump to MISER API 2Ch (pm_record_service).

3F50.name: byte_to_hex_ascii
3F50.comment: AL -> two hex digits (AL low nibble in AL, high in AH) as ASCII. No caller found.

3F7C.name: setup_reboot
3F7C.comment: Clears the screen (INT 10h scroll, 25x80), prints msg_rebooting, KBC D1h DFh (A20), FEh (pulse reset), HLT. Reached from setup_save_and_reboot (pop-up F4).

3F18.name: byte_to_2digit_ascii
3F18.comment: AL (0-99) -> two ASCII digits in AX.

0103.name: setup_key_maps
0103.comment: Four NUL-terminated (scancode, handler) lists used by the SETUP key dispatcher: 2Bh/20h/4Dh/4Eh/39h -> setup_key_next_value (269A), 2Dh/4Bh/4Ah -> setup_key_prev_value (2730), 1Bh/01h Esc -> setup_key_escape (1FF9), 50h Down -> 25E8, 48h Up -> 25EF, 51h PgDn -> 2668, 49h PgUp -> 2681, 42h F8 -> 3AFA, 0Eh Backspace -> 2767, 08h -> 2355.

269A.name: setup_key_next_value
269A.comment: Right / + / Space: advance the current field to the next option.

1FF9.name: setup_key_escape
1FF9.comment: Esc: leaves the current menu (picks 287A or 2896 depending on the page).

25E8.name: setup_key_down
25E8.comment: Down: redraw the current field unhighlighted, setup_field_next.

2767.name: setup_key_backspace
2767.comment: Backspace on a non-numeric field: beep (setup_key_default).

3AFA.name: cmos_shadow_flush
3AFA.comment: Writes the 72h shadow bytes back to CMOS 0Eh-7Fh (cmos_hw_write). Called on F4 save.

15E9.name: setup_extended_scancodes
15E9.comment: Scancode list H K M P ; < ? @ E R S > I Q (cursor keys, F1-F6, Ins/Del, PgUp/PgDn) + 01 39 4E 4A 0C 0D - the keys the SETUP key handler recognises.

1691.name: setup_word_table_1691
1691.comment: Words 0Ch, 0..5 (field index table, best guess) followed by a 4-byte stub.

1FCF.name: setup_page_string_ptrs
1FCF.comment: 21 near pointers into the SETUP string area (0948h, 095Ch, 0952h, 0966h, 0970h, 097Ah...): title/legend strings per page.

27D9.name: setup_frame_char_table
27D9.comment: 12 records (row, col, char, count word): box corners and horizontal rules (C9h, CDh, BBh, C7h, C4h, B6h, C8h, BCh) of the SETUP frame.

285E.name: setup_string_ptrs_285E
285E.comment: 56 near pointers into the 06xxh SETUP strings (option names for the fields).

91B0.name: kbd_translate_tables
91B0.comment: Keyboard translation tables: 91B0 base (scancode -> ASCII: Esc 1..0 -= BS Tab qwerty...), 9208 shift, 9260 ctrl, 92B8 alt/numpad, 9310 num-lock keypad (see int09_kbd_irq_body).

9E98.name: table_9E98
9E98.comment: Byte records (09 00 DF 02 25 02 09 2A FF 50 F6 0F 06 27 80 01 ...) - keyboard-controller / speed table, format not decoded.

A0FB.name: floppy_dispatch_tail
A0FB.comment: Continuation of the pointer table at A0C9 (A166 x 7, A9FE).

A667.name: floppy_gap_table
A667.comment: Bytes 04 04 04 04 04 06 06 02 02 02 04 04 06 06 04 01 04 03 04 06 - diskette format/gap parameters per drive/media type.

AC2F.name: rom_option_strings
AC2F.comment: 'Default configuration...' and other ROM option strings.

ACFB.name: rom_option_far_ptr_table
ACFB.comment: Far pointers (F000:...) to configuration tables: 9E98, 94E9, E6F5 (system configuration table), AF43, AF63, AF53, AD4F, AFA3, AFB1, AFBF; 0000:0000 ends it. Reached through the far pointer at F000:FF64.

D59D.name: pmode_descriptor_D59D
D59D.comment: Descriptor image: limit 0020h base 0 type 93h... used by the protected-mode memory routines.

D99C.name: cpu_type_table
D99C.comment: (mask, value, pointer) records for the CPU identification: 04 00 -> D94F, 04 10 -> D94F, 04 20 -> D956, 04 30 -> D95D, 04 80 -> D965 ... (name strings '486 DX', '486 SX'...).

58A6.name: post_kbc_reset_continue
58A6.comment: Fragment after a POST step: speaker off (61h &= FDh), CX=200, ROM stack at 58BA, jump on.

95F4.name: cmos_ext_checksum_calc
95F4.comment: Sums CMOS 40h-7Dh (index written with NMI disabled bit 80h, port EDh delays) -> BX; compares/stores at 7Eh/7Fh (Phoenix extended checksum, same algorithm as MISER's cmos_ext_checksum_update).

9905.name: miser_record_service_call
9905.comment: DS := BDA, BL := AL, AX=0301h, lcall E800:002C (MISER pm_record_service) - the system BIOS side of the SETUP/PM record interface.

C4A7.name: cmos_write_al_ah
C4A7.comment: pushf/cli, index AH -> 70h, value AL -> 71h with port EDh delays.

CCB9.name: chipset_reg9_reg3_write
CCB9.comment: shl eax,16; chipset reg 9 (24h/26h) then reg 3 written.

CD1E.name: chipset_reg9_write_021F
CD1E.comment: Chipset reg 9 := 021Fh via the write helper.

CF62.name: int_handler_tail_CF62
CF62.comment: call ...; AH := 0; STI; pop di/ds; RETF 2 (end of an INT service).

D21B.name: clear_memory_pages
D21B.comment: ES := BP; zero 512 words; BP += 40h (1 KB steps) until BP == SI - clears a memory range in 1 KB blocks.

D4C2.name: set_ds_from_D4A5_and_jump
D4C2.comment: DS := cs:[D4A5]; [001C] := SI; DS := cs:[D49F]; STI; call/jmp continuation.

D4FE.name: toupper_if_letter
D4FE.comment: If BL bit 6 and not bits 0-1: converts 'a'-'z' in AL to upper case (keyboard shift/caps handling).

DA2A.name: cpu_speed_loop_retf
DA2A.comment: xor ax,ax; xor dx,dx; loop; PIT ch2 := 0; RETF - the timed loop used by the CPU speed display (called far so it can run from RAM/ROM alike); followed by a div-loop variant.

786C.name: print_addr_and_dash
786C.comment: Prints BX as hex (two calls) followed by '0000-' - used by the memory-test failure address display.

78BB.name: video_mode3_if_needed
78BB.comment: INT 10h AX=0003h BH=0 then checks DH < 18h.

7B49.name: cmos_0E_diag_test
7B49.comment: AL := CMOS 0Eh; test AL & FCh (any diagnostic error bit).

7B53.name: setup_far_ptr_7B53
7B53.comment: Far pointer F000:0100 (SETUP entry) and constants used by the hot-key path.

A9FE.name: floppy_motor_check
A9FE.comment: call ...; AH := 30h ... diskette status/motor handling fragment (floppy driver internals).

B79F.name: video_page_from_bda
B79F.comment: BL := 40:62 (active page) unless mode < 4, BH := BL.

B91A.name: move_words_with_offsets
B91A.comment: SI += DX, DI += DX, copy CX bytes (movsb + rep movsw) - screen scroll helper.

97D9.name: pmode_table_walk_tail
97D9.comment: Continuation of a protected-mode loop: DI += 10h per descriptor, then CR0.PE off, far jump to 97F4, reload DS/ES/SS.

194D.name: setup_after_cmos_write
194D.comment: Continuation after the call at 194A (SETUP screen refresh: INT 10h AH=0Fh/05h/03h/02h).

1B33.name: setup_save_and_reboot
1B33.comment: Pop-up F4: if VersaPort is not 'external floppy' clears the external floppy type in CMOS 10h, then cmos_shadow_flush and setup_reboot.

2A0A.name: setup_attributes_init
2A0A.comment: Initialises the colour attribute set in the SETUP work area ([bp+17]..[bp+1B] := 07h/70h/0Fh/70h/70h ...).

2CC4.name: setup_hd_type_read
2CC4.comment: CMOS 12h low nibble; 0Fh -> extended type from CMOS 1Ah (types 16-47).

2F14.name: display_field_read
2F14.comment: CMOS 1Fh bit 1 set -> value 4, else CMOS 14h bits 4-5 (initial video mode).

3715.name: setup_draw_field_box
3715.comment: Fills a 6-character field box with spaces then draws the value from record [bx+1C].

E831.name: fill_E831
E831.comment: FFh fill between the option-ROM area and int16 fixed entry (E82E).

3AE5.name: cmos_shadow_load
3AE5.comment: Copies CMOS 0Eh-7Fh (72h bytes, cmos_hw_read) into the SETUP stack frame at [bp+65+index] - SETUP edits this shadow and writes it back only on save.

3B2F.name: cmos_shadow_read
3B2F.comment: AL := shadow byte for CMOS index AL ([bp+si+73h], si = index-0Eh).

3B3E.name: cmos_shadow_write
3B3E.comment: Shadow byte for CMOS index AL := BH.

15FE.name: setup_in_popup
15FE.comment: ZF clear when 40:B6 bit 1 is set - SETUP was started as PhoenixMISER's pop-up (bda_popup_mark_set); keyboard then comes straight from the KBC (popup_read_key) instead of INT 16h.

1539.name: popup_read_key
1539.comment: Pop-up keyboard reader: polls 64h/60h directly (redrawing the clock while idle), treats E0h as a prefix (40:B6 bit 7), maps extended scancodes (setup_extended_scancodes) to AL=0/AH=scancode, digit keys 02h-0Bh to '1'..'0', Backspace to 08h; unknown keys beep (setup_key_default).

160D.name: setup_shadow_cmos48_update
160D.comment: Derives a bit mask from CX (video ROM size in 32 KB units, video_rom_size_32k_units) and updates CMOS 48h in the shadow (shadow-RAM configuration, best guess), then redraws the following fields.

1627.name: setup_shadow_cmos48_tail
1627.comment: Continuation: BH bit 0 selects set/clear, writes CMOS 48h, setup_redraw_following_fields, setup_ext_checksum_to_shadow.

1644.name: option_rom_size_at_es
1644.comment: CX := 0 when ES:0000 is not 55AAh, else rom_size_from_header.

1655.name: rom_size_from_header
1655.comment: CX := ES:[2] (512-byte units) / 64 rounded up = size in 32 KB blocks.

166F.name: setup_redraw_following_fields
166F.comment: Unless [bp+2E] bit 1: redraws the next CX-1 field records (handler +6 and setup_draw_field).

16A3.name: setup_draw_gauge_test
16A3.comment: Draws the gauge with the test value C3h (76 %) - debugging leftover.

16AA.name: setup_draw_gauge
16AA.comment: AL (0-255) -> percentage (scale_to_percent), printed at row 10h col 47h-49h with attribute 70h (draw_percent_at_col_47), then draw_gauge_bar_cmos13. Best guess: battery level display of the Power page.

16D4.name: draw_percent_at_col_47
16D4.comment: Prints the 1-3 digit percentage at cursor row DH, columns 47h-49h.

1720.name: draw_gauge_bar_cmos13
1720.comment: Shadow CMOS 13h -> 0/1/2.. -> prints that many 08h characters at col 13h (bar).

174E.name: int10_write_char_attr
174E.comment: INT 10h AH=09h (AL char, BL attribute, CX count).

176B.name: versaport_next_option
176B.comment: VersaPort field +: option index 0-4 external floppy types, 5/6 parallel standard/bidirectional, 7/8 EPP 1.7/1.9 (skips gaps), then versaport_apply_option.

1797.name: versaport_prev_option
1797.comment: VersaPort field -: previous option (wraps 0 -> 4, skips the gaps), then versaport_apply_option.

17BF.name: versaport_apply_option
17BF.comment: Option 0-4 -> CMOS 10h low nibble (external floppy type); 5/6 -> CMOS 59h bit 2 (bidirectional); 7/8 -> CMOS 59h bit 3 (EPP 1.9); updates the shadow checksum fields.

181C.name: versaport_read_option
181C.comment: CMOS 59h bits 0-1: 1 = external floppy -> option = CMOS 10h low nibble (0-6); 0 = parallel -> 5 + bit 2; 2 = EPP -> 7 + bit 3. Stores the option in the field value array.

1BA3.name: setup_attributes_color
1BA3.comment: Colour attribute set for the SETUP frame: [bp+17..21] := 70h,1Fh,1Fh,3Eh,20h,1Fh,4Fh,70h,70h,10h,70h (mono set is setup_attributes_init), then setup_load_key_maps and the field init.

1BE8.name: setup_load_key_maps
1BE8.comment: Copies the (scancode, handler) key maps into the frame: ASCII map 0103h (pop-up) or 0129h (normal) -> [bp+4D]; extended map 0113h or 0139h -> [bp+5D].

1C29.name: setup_ptl_table_key_patch
1C29.comment: If the OEM 'PTL' configuration record 14h (sysconfig_ptl_lookup) has bit 5 clear: replaces the '=' key handler in the extended map with setup_key_default and fixes strings 6E7h at [bp+3D]/[bp+3F].

1D10.name: setup_cmos_corrections
1D10.comment: If the correction flags [bp+2F] are non-zero: setup_correction_screen.

1D17.name: setup_correction_screen
1D17.comment: Draws the 'CMOS corrected' page: for each set bit of [bp+2F] prints the message of setup_cmos_correction_table and calls its handler (fix_*), then waits for a key and clears CMOS 0Eh.

1E6A.name: cmos_set_base_memory
1E6A.comment: INT 15h AH=BBh (Phoenix, returns base size in DX when supported) else 40:13; rounded up to 32 KB, clamped to 640/1024 KB -> CMOS 15h/16h.

1EAB.name: cmos_set_ext_memory
1EAB.comment: INT 15h AH=BBh or CMOS 30h/31h -> CMOS 17h/18h (extended memory size).

1F1D.name: shadow_clear_range
1F1D.comment: Shadow bytes for CMOS indexes AL..AH := 0.

1F36.name: setup_init_all_fields
1F36.comment: Loads page 0 fields 6.. and page 1 fields 0-5 from CMOS (setup_init_fields_range / setup_init_page1_fields).

1F50.name: setup_init_page1_fields
1F50.comment: Loads the six page-2 (Power & Video) fields from CMOS, then re-selects page 0 field 0.

1F6D.name: setup_init_fields_range
1F6D.comment: For CX records: when DH=0 only records with CMOS index <= 3Fh, when DH=1 those with 40h-7Fh, call setup_field_load_from_cmos.

1FA5.name: setup_field_load_from_cmos
1FA5.comment: Field kinds 1-5 are skipped; otherwise handler +10h (CMOS read) with AL = default (+19h).

216F.name: setup_confirm_box
216F.comment: Draws the confirmation box (strings 0400h/0410h at rows 5/12) and waits for a key.

21D4.name: print_string_crlf_at
21D4.comment: Prints the NUL-terminated string at SI with INT 10h AH=0Eh, handling CR (back to column CL) and LF (next row).

2212.name: setup_clear_screen
2212.comment: INT 10h AH=06h full-screen scroll with attribute [bp+19].

2301.name: setup_option_string_select
2301.comment: Skips AL NUL-terminated option strings (max 50h chars each) in the list at ES:DI -> SI. Page-1 fields 1-4 show option 0 when Power Management (CMOS 42h bits 0-1) is off.

2355.name: setup_field_handler_E
2355.comment: Calls handler +0Eh of the current record.

235C.name: setup_field_handler_6
235C.comment: Calls handler +06h (draw) of the current record.

2381.name: setup_draw_all_field_values
2381.comment: Handler +6 for every record of the page.

23A5.name: sysconfig_ptl_lookup
23A5.comment: INT 15h AH=C0h; if the configuration table carries the 'PTL' tag (E6F5+0Eh), follows the far pointer at F000:FF64 to rom_option_far_ptr_table and loads DS:SI with entry BX; CF=1 when absent.

23EF.name: setup_cursor_hide
23EF.comment: INT 10h AH=01h CX=0F00h then CRTC 0Ah (port [bp+15]) := 2Fh (cursor off).

2407.name: kbd_buffer_push
2407.comment: Stores AX at the keyboard buffer tail 40:1C (wrap at 40:82/80).

244D.name: setup_frame_segment
244D.comment: Chooses the 4 KB RAM area for the SETUP stack frame: with CMOS 0Eh diagnostics clean and PhoenixMISER initialised (E800:0040 query_state_34, E800:0038 presence) ES := DF00h (MISER's spare segment), else setup_find_free_top_memory.

246E.name: setup_find_free_top_memory
246E.comment: Scans down from top-of-memory minus 36 KB in 4 KB steps for an all-zero 4 KB block; ES = segment, DL = 1 when a non-zero block had to be used (must be cleared).

24A6.name: clear_4k_at_es
24A6.comment: Zeroes 800h words at ES:0000 (the 4 KB SETUP frame).

24B3.name: setup_field_next
24B3.comment: Cursor down: skips the extra rows of list/disk-type kinds (22h/33h/77h) and the page-1 hidden rows.

25F6.name: setup_init_pages_draw
25F6.comment: Runs setup_draw_all_field_values for both pages, then selects page 0 (page 1 in the pop-up) field 0.

2A90.name: field_value_get
2A90.comment: AL := value byte of the current field ([bp+2C] + [bp+2B]).

2A9E.name: field_value_set
2A9E.comment: Value byte of the current field := AL.

2B06.name: list_field_write_cmos
2B06.comment: Value << +18h merged into CMOS +14h under mask +15h (shadow), then handler +12h.

2B28.name: floppy_field_next
2B28.comment: Skips value 5 (2.88 MB only when supported).

2B3A.name: floppy_field_prev
2B3A.comment: Floppy field -: skips value 5 (2.88 MB) downwards, then list_field_prev_value.

2B6F.name: floppy_A_write_cmos10
2B6F.comment: Value -> CMOS 10h bits 4-7; CMOS 1Fh bit 2 := (no floppy).

2C23.name: hd_read_cmos12
2C23.comment: Pop-up only: CMOS 12h high nibble (0Fh -> CMOS 19h) -> value (<= 2Fh, else 6).

2C55.name: hd_write_cmos12_19
2C55.comment: Value < 0Fh -> CMOS 12h high nibble, else 0Fh there and the type in CMOS 19h.

2CED.name: hd2_write_cmos12_1A
2CED.comment: Second drive: CMOS 12h low nibble / CMOS 1Ah.

2E1F.name: kb_value_to_string
2E1F.comment: AX KB -> 'nnnnn KB' text at SS:DI ('' string 0C62h for 0).

2E39.name: decimal_kb_format
2E39.comment: Right-aligns the decimal digits of AX (1-5 digits) and appends ' KB' (append_KB_suffix).

2E7B.name: append_KB_suffix
2E7B.comment: Appends ' KB' and a NUL after the BX-digit number at SS:DI (itoa_right_aligned).

2EB8.name: ext_memory_field_refresh
2EB8.comment: Recomputes CMOS 17h/18h from the hardware (cmos_set_ext_memory) when they read FFFFh.

2F39.name: display_field_write
2F39.comment: Value -> CMOS 14h bits 4-5 (value 4 clears CMOS 1Fh bit 1, else sets it).

2F65.name: cmos1F_bit1_set
2F65.comment: CMOS 1Fh |= 02h (initial video mode override flag) and checksum update.

2F77.name: cmos4E_bit0_field_read
2F77.comment: Value := CMOS 4Eh bit 0 (max 1) into the field array.

2F97.name: hd_type_list_screen
2F97.comment: Hard-disk type chooser: uses the OEM 'PTL' table entry 4 or the ROM table F000:E401; draws the type list (14-char names, cylinders/heads/sectors) in pages and reads keys until a type is picked.

30D5.name: hd_type_detail_draw
30D5.comment: Prints Cylinders / Heads / Sectors / Size for type AX at rows 10h-13h col 2Dh: 0 -> the 'Not installed' strings, 2Eh/2Dh -> user-defined values from CMOS, 2Fh -> geometry from IDENTIFY DEVICE (ide_identify_geometry), others from the ROM table.

311D.name: hd_type_detail_none
311D.comment: Prints the four 'not installed' detail strings (1083h..) for hard-disk type 0.

31BE.name: hd_detail_print_values
31BE.comment: CX cylinders, AH heads, AL sectors -> the four value fields.

3215.name: ide_identify_geometry
3215.comment: ATA ECh IDENTIFY DEVICE on 1F7h, waits for DRQ; CX := cylinders (word 1), BL := heads (word 3), BH := sectors (word 6); CF=1 on timeout.

325C.name: user_type_detail_from_cmos
325C.comment: CL := CMOS base 20h (type 2Eh, user 1) or 35h (type 2Fh, user 2): the user-defined geometry lives in CMOS 20h-2Fh / 35h-3Fh.

3267.name: user_type_detail_print
3267.comment: Prints cylinders (+0/+1), heads (+2), write-precomp (+3/+4), landing zone (+5/+6), sectors (+7) and size from the CMOS block.

332C.name: user_type_size_print
332C.comment: Reads cylinders (+0/+1), heads (+2) and sectors (+7) of the user-geometry CMOS block CL and prints the size in MB (print_size_mb).

3364.name: print_cyl_field
3364.comment: AX -> 4 digits (or '-1') at SS:BP, then print_field_string_ss.

33A3.name: print_2digit_field
33A3.comment: AL (0-99) -> 2 right-aligned digits at SS:BP+1, print_field_string_ss at DX.

33CA.name: print_4digit_or_minus1
33CA.comment: AX -> 4 digits, or ' -1' when negative, at SS:BP.

347F.name: print_size_mb
347F.comment: cylinders (CX) x heads (AH) x sectors (AL) / 2048 -> MB, 3 digits.

34D2.name: user_geom_field_draw
34D2.comment: Draws one user-geometry field (word or byte from CMOS base + record +14h/+1Dh).

350F.name: user_geom_cmos_base
350F.comment: CH := 20h / 35h (user type 1 / 2) or 0 depending on the disk-type value of the owning field.

3533.name: user_geom_clamp_write
3533.comment: Clamps the CMOS field at 20h+/35h+ (+14h) to the record maximum (+16h).

356A.name: user_geom_key_edit
356A.comment: Digit entry for the user geometry: '-' sets -1, Backspace deletes (user_geom_backspace), digits append with range check (+16h), then handler +10h and a redraw of the size field.

3623.name: user_geom_hd_pair_refresh
3623.comment: When CMOS 19h == 1Ah (both drives user-defined) and CMOS 12h == FFh: redraws the partner field 6 records away.

368B.name: user_geom_backspace
368B.comment: Divides the current value by 10 and redraws.

36EA.name: user_geom_cmos_write
36EA.comment: AX -> CMOS base+14h (and +1Dh high byte), then handler +12h.

374F.name: user_geom_validate_both
374F.comment: Clamps the user-1 (20h+) and user-2 (35h+) fields to the record maximum.

37C8.name: rtc_to_dos_time_date
37C8.comment: If INT 21h is installed: rtc_time_to_ticks_40_6C and rtc_date_to_dos_int21_2B (keeps DOS in step after the clock was edited).

3842.name: rtc_date_to_dos_int21_2B
3842.comment: CMOS century/year/month/day -> INT 21h AH=2Bh (set DOS date).

38C3.name: cmos_ext_checksum_calc
38C3.comment: Indexes 40h-7Dh (3Eh bytes) -> BH/SI for the Phoenix extended checksum (7Eh/7Fh).

38CC.name: cmos_sum_range
38CC.comment: Sums CX shadow bytes from index BL nibble-wise -> BH (low byte) / SI (high byte).

3901.name: rtc_validate_or_reset
3901.comment: Range-checks the BCD time/date (hours < 24, minutes/seconds < 60, century 19/20, year, month 1-12, day within the month); invalid -> rtc_reset_defaults.

39CE.name: rtc_status_regs_fix
39CE.comment: If CMOS 0Eh bits 7/2 (power lost / time invalid): status A := 26h, status B := 02h, read C/D; else make sure status B bit 1 (24 h mode) is set.

3A04.name: rtc_wait_uip_snapshot_sec
3A04.comment: Waits for UIP clear and remembers the seconds byte at [bp-1].

3A17.name: rtc_seconds_changed
3A17.comment: ZF = seconds unchanged since rtc_wait_uip_snapshot_sec (read is consistent).

3A21.name: rtc_read_time
3A21.comment: CH hours, CL minutes, DH seconds (BCD), re-read until consistent.

3A49.name: rtc_read_date
3A49.comment: CH century (fixed to 20h when 19xx has rolled over), CL year, DH month, DL day (BCD).

3A90.name: rtc_write_time
3A90.comment: CMOS 04h := CH hours, 02h := CL minutes, 00h := DH seconds (BCD), retried until the seconds do not tick during the write.

3AB6.name: rtc_write_date
3AB6.comment: CMOS 32h := CH century, 09h := CL year, 08h := DH month, 07h := DL day (BCD).

3C46.name: int10_put_char_at
3C46.comment: Cursor to DX then INT 10h AH=09h.

3C55.name: field_pos_attr_for_index
3C55.comment: DX := row/col of record CH, SI := SS:BP text, BL := attribute (highlight when CH is the current field).

3C77.name: time_hours_inc
3C77.comment: Hours field +: BCD increment, wraps 23 -> 0, rtc_write_time.

3D2F.name: time_seconds_zero
3D2F.comment: Seconds field: any key resets the seconds to 0 and writes the time.

3D44.name: time_seconds_zero_b
3D44.comment: Second copy of time_seconds_zero (used by the other key).

3D59.name: date_month_inc
3D59.comment: Month +: 12 -> 1, clamps the day to the month length (days_in_month_lookup), rtc_write_date.

3DD2.name: date_day_inc
3DD2.comment: Day +: wraps at the month length (leap years honoured).

3E8B.name: date_year_dec
3E8B.comment: Year -: 00 of century 20h -> 99 of 19h; 1980-style floor at 80 of 19h; February 29 clamped.

3EE2.name: days_in_month_lookup
3EE2.comment: BL := days of month DH (table 0C56h, +1 for February in a leap year CL).

3F0A.name: bcd_to_ascii_pair
3F0A.comment: BCD AL -> two ASCII digits in AL/AH.

3F24.name: itoa_right_aligned
3F24.comment: AX -> up to BX decimal digits written right-to-left at SS:DI.

1B5A.name: setup_exit
1B5A.comment: Clears the screen, POST 44h-47h, restores the caller's stack, flushes the keyboard buffer (pop-up: pushes 1C0Dh Enter), clears 40:B5 bit 0, RETF.

2285.name: setup_redraw_current_field
2285.comment: Redraws the current field highlighted (attribute [bp+18]): time/date rows via setup_draw_time_date, option lists via setup_option_string_select, kind 55h fields also call their secondary handler (+1Ah) and label position (+1Ch/+1Dh); then setup_draw_field_hint.

22E4.name: setup_draw_field_hint
22E4.comment: Prints the field hint string (0679h for value-type 11h fields, 0663h otherwise) at row 16h col 39h with attribute [bp+1F].

276A.name: setup_draw_frame_border
276A.comment: INT 10h clear, vertical bars (BAh) in columns 0 and 4Fh of rows 1-23, then the corner/edge characters from setup_frame_char_table.

2815.name: setup_draw_title_bar
2815.comment: Clears rows 1-2 and prints the title strings 05B4h / 05F1h.

2836.name: setup_draw_key_legend
2836.comment: Prints 7 (key, description) string pairs from the pointer list at [di] on rows 16h/17h, 0Bh columns apart (bottom legend).

28EC.name: setup_scroll_window
28EC.comment: INT 10h AH=07h: clears the window CX..DX with attribute BH.

29BF.name: setup_draw_shadow
29BF.comment: Draws the box shadow: DBh down the right edge and DFh along the bottom of the window CX..DX.

29F9.name: setup_attributes_from_table
29F9.comment: Copies CX attribute bytes from [si] into [bp+17..].

2A37.name: setup_init_legend_strings
2A37.comment: Fills the legend pointer slots [bp+31..4B] with the string offsets 0637h, 0642h, 06E7h..., 064Dh, 0658h, 0663h, 066Eh and 0684h/068Fh (or 06E7h when the extra keys are disabled).

2D42.name: base_memory_field_refresh
2D42.comment: Recomputes CMOS 15h/16h from the hardware when the value exceeds 1024.

2D5D.name: base_memory_field_write
2D5D.comment: AX -> CMOS 15h/16h (base memory KB) in the shadow, checksum update.

2D71.name: numeric_field_key_edit
2D71.comment: Generic numeric editor: Backspace -> numeric_field_backspace; digits are appended (value*10+digit, clamped to +16h) to the CMOS word at +14h/+1Dh, then handler +10h and a redraw. First digit after entering the field replaces the value ([bp+1A offset] flag byte).

3FB3.name: kbc_wait_input_empty_setup
3FB3.comment: Spin until 64h bit 1 clears (used by setup_reboot).

675E.name: kbc_drain_output_buffer
675E.comment: Reads up to 4 pending bytes from 60h (each waiting up to 800 x 100 refresh ticks for 64h bit 0).

6D44.name: detect_serial_parallel_ports
6D44.comment: probe_port_table over the serial table 6D24 (probe_serial_port) and the parallel table (probe_parallel_port); BL := serial count, AL << 4 := parallel count for the equipment word.

6DE2.name: uart_set_divisor
6DE2.comment: LCR (DX) := 80h (DLAB), divisor low := BL, high := BH (port EDh delays).

6FA6.name: beep_hi_pair
6FA6.comment: Two high beeps separated by a wait_refresh_cycles delay (POST beep-code element).

7083.name: kbc_wait_output_50
7083.comment: Up to 50 x 100 refresh ticks for 64h bit 0 (output buffer full).

7092.name: kbc_wait_output_dx
7092.comment: Up to DX x 100 refresh ticks for 64h bit 0.

70A1.name: kbc_short_delay
70A1.comment: wait_refresh_cycles based delay used between keyboard-controller commands.

71DD.name: clear_low_idt_gdt
71DD.comment: Zeroes 444h words at 0000:D0A0 (IDT at D0A0, GDT at D8A0 used by the protected-mode POST code).

728E.name: pmode_ret_ss58
728E.comment: SS := selector 58h, popa, CLC, ret (protected-mode stack switch helper).

7316.name: descriptor_base_to_segment
7316.comment: AX := (base bits 4-19 of the descriptor at DS:SI) as a real-mode segment.

84DA.name: hd_short_delay
84DA.comment: wait_refresh_cycles with BX=0Fh (about 1 ms) used between IDE register accesses.

8619.name: cpu_speed_set_level
8619.comment: AH = level 0/1/2 -> speed value from ROM options AF5Dh/AF5Fh/AF5Eh; when ROM option AF46h bit 0 allows it, set_cpu_speed; then cpu_speed_get_level.

8654.name: nop_push_pop
8654.comment: push ax; pop ax; ret (hook placeholder).

8657.name: cpu_speed_get_level
8657.comment: AH := 0/1/2 by comparing the current speed value (cpu_speed_current_value) with the ROM option values; AL := 3.

8673.name: cpu_speed_current_value
8673.comment: AL := ROM option AF5Dh unless 40:B5 bit 2 says the alternate speed is active.

8771.name: hotkey_cpu_speed_select
8771.comment: Keyboard hot keys from ROM options AF56h/AF57h/AF58h select CPU speed level 0/1/2 (cpu_speed_set_level), with speed_change_click when AF55h bit 0.

87A1.name: hotkey_cpu_speed_toggle_pair
87A1.comment: Two hot keys toggle between low/high and mid/high speed.

87D9.name: hotkey_cpu_speed_toggle
87D9.comment: One hot key toggles between high and low speed.

880C.name: speed_change_click
880C.comment: If 40:B5 bit 2: a speaker click (sub_D174) with a wait_refresh_cycles delay - audible feedback for the speed hot keys.

89F2.name: uart_program_divisor
89F2.comment: LCR := 80h, divisor := BX (low/high), DX preserved (port EDh delays).

9172.name: kbd_shift_flags_set
9172.comment: Sets the shift-state bit CL in 40:17 (BL), 40:18 (BH, rotated) or 40:96 (CH) depending on CH bit 1 (E0 prefix).

9188.name: kbd_shift_flags_clear
9188.comment: Clears the same bits; when neither the left nor the right key is still down clears the combined flag in BL.

93A2.name: kbd_buffer_advance
93A2.comment: DI += 2 with wrap at 40:82 -> 40:80; ZF when DI == 40:1A (buffer full).

93BE.name: kbc_wait_input_empty_timeout
93BE.comment: wait_refresh_cycles-timed wait for 64h bit 1 clear; ZF = ready.

93DB.name: kbd_send_byte_retry3
93DB.comment: Sends AH to the keyboard (60h) up to 3 times until FAh (ACK) or FEh (resend) comes back; CF=1 on failure; clears 40:97 bits 4-5 first.

9412.name: kbc_enable_keyboard_AE
9412.comment: Waits for the input buffer, then KBC command AEh (enable keyboard interface).

941C.name: kbc_disable_keyboard_AD
941C.comment: Waits for the input buffer, then KBC command ADh (disable keyboard interface); STI.

945E.name: gate_a20_kbc_path
945E.comment: Shared body of gate_a20_enable/disable through the keyboard controller: D1h then AH (DFh on / DDh off) to the output port.

9904.name: speed_hook_stub
9904.comment: ret - placeholder called by the speed_low/mid/high routines.

991D.name: gate_a20_enable_alt
991D.comment: KBC D1h DFh without the timeout waits (ROM option AF47h bit 7 path).

994A.name: shadow_ram_setup
994A.comment: POST shadow-RAM enable: with AH bit 4 set runs shadow_enable_from_ram (the ROM copies itself to 1000:0000 and continues there while the F000 shadow is switched on).

99A6.name: shadow_enable_from_ram
99A6.comment: Runs in the RAM copy: chipset reg 200h |= 1000h (F000 shadow enable) via 24h/26h, then copies the ROM into the shadow and jumps back.

9A65.name: shadow_reg200_set_bits_from_ram
9A65.comment: Same trick for arbitrary reg 200h bits in BX (copies 8 KB to 1000:0000 first).

9B56.name: memory_present_test
9B56.comment: Fills CX x 512 bytes at segment AX with 55AAh and verifies; CF=1 when the RAM is missing or bad.

9B82.name: cpu_speed_low_post_B0
9B82.comment: POST B0h/B1h: speed level 2 via speed_hook_stub (ROM-stack return).

9E46.name: chipset_200_207_bits23_set
9E46.comment: Chipset regs 200h/207h |= 0Ch (shadow-RAM write enable bits, best guess).

9E80.name: floppy_flags_clear_bit0_set_bit9
9E80.comment: [bp+1A] &= FEh, [bp+1B] |= 2 (request flags in the INT 13h frame).

9F27.name: floppy_reset_and_probe_fdc
9F27.comment: floppy_reset_controller, fdc_dumpreg_probe; 40:3F bit 7 := enhanced controller (82077-class) when the probe returned 2.

9F3C.name: floppy_dor_reset_pulse
9F3C.comment: DOR (3F2h) := motor bits from 40:3F | 08h (IRQ/DMA on, reset asserted), 5-tick delay, then | 04h (reset released).

9FAD.name: floppy_motor_spinup_wait
9FAD.comment: If the motor-off counter 40:40 is FEh/FFh (motor just started) waits 4000 refresh ticks.

9FC6.name: floppy_motor_timeout_check
9FC6.comment: Compares 40:40 with 255 - (DPT motor-off delay [si+0A] x 2.25); CF when the motor has run long enough.

9FE9.name: floppy_motor_start_wait
9FE9.comment: If the motor is not up to speed: INT 15h AX=90FDh (device-busy hook: diskette motor start - PhoenixMISER listens here), then a 1 s wait_refresh_cycles delay unless the hook returned CF.

A015.name: floppy_motor_count_set
A015.comment: 40:40 := DPT motor-off delay (+2) adjusted when the counter was already above EDh.

A1E0.name: fdc_read_result_bytes_cx
A1E0.comment: Reads up to CX result bytes from 3F5h (RQM and DIO set) into 40:42..; on a premature RQM without DIO sets status 20h.

A205.name: fdc_read_2_results
A205.comment: Two result bytes -> AX (AH = ST0, AL = second byte), 40:42/43 preserved.

A21B.name: fdc_st1_error_codes
A21B.comment: INT 13h status for ST1 bits 7..0: 04h (sector not found), 20h, 10h (CRC), 08h (DMA overrun), 20h, 04h, 03h (write protect), 02h (address mark).

A272.name: fdc_write_bytes_cs_bx
A272.comment: Writes CX command bytes from CS:BX to the FDC (fdc_write_byte_cf).

A298.name: fdc_dumpreg_probe
A298.comment: Command 0Eh (DUMPREG): AL = 0 (no response), 1 (8272 answers 80h invalid), 2 (enhanced controller returned the 10 register bytes).

A2B7.name: floppy_select_data_rate
A2B7.comment: 40:8B |= FEh; CCR 3F7h := data rate from DPT+0Ch merged with 40:8B bit 0 and the drive.

A329.name: fdc_sense_drive_status
A329.comment: 10000-tick delay, command 04h + head/drive; ZF from ST3 bit 4 (track 0).

A536.name: floppy_seek_if_needed
A536.comment: Recalibrate first when 40:3E says the drive is uncalibrated (floppy_recalibrate); seek only when the cached track 40:494+drive differs from CH.

A552.name: fdc_seek
A552.comment: Command 0Fh, head/drive, cylinder CH; updates the track cache 40:494+drive; then fdc_wait_seek_complete.

A56D.name: fdc_wait_seek_complete
