A56D.comment: Waits for the FDC IRQ (floppy_wait_irq, reset on timeout), 100-tick delay, sense interrupt, checks the drive number in ST0, then head-settle delay from DPT+9 (default 15 ms).

A5EB.name: floppy_recalibrate
A5EB.comment: fdc_recalibrate_cmd; a 'seek end + equipment check' (ST0 & D0h == 50h) is accepted as track 0 after 80 steps.

A64C.name: floppy_drive_count_from_48F
A64C.comment: DL := number of drives with a type in 40:8F (low/high nibble).

A6C2.name: floppy_disabled_check
A6C2.comment: CF=1 when ROM option AF46h bit 5 is clear, or bit 3 set and CMOS 1Fh bit 2 (no floppy) set.

A8F9.name: floppy_media_state_step
A8F9.comment: Advances the media-state byte 40:490+drive to the next data-rate trial (table floppy_media_state_table).

AAB8.name: floppy_disk_change_check
AAB8.comment: DIR 3F7h bit 7 (disk change): when set, floppy_media_state_step and returns AL=80h with SF.

AAC8.name: floppy_disk_change_reset
AAC8.comment: Clears the change line by seeking to track 4 (fdc_seek) and recalibrating; AH := 06h (change line active) or 80h/CF when it stays set.

AB0C.name: floppy_change_check_with_motor
AB0C.comment: floppy_motor_on then floppy_disk_change_reset for known drive types.

AB3A.name: post_floppy_seek_test
AB3A.comment: POST diskette test: skipped (AL=3) when 40:B6 bit 0 (Quick Boot); else motor on, two recalibrations, head settle and a seek check.

AC0C.name: fdc_msr_busy_check
AC0C.comment: Counts the drive-busy bits in the MSR (3F4h bits 0-3); CF=1 when more than one is set or bit 0-3 patterns are inconsistent.

B315.name: int10_write_char_wait_retrace
B315.comment: For CGA modes 2/3 waits for horizontal retrace on 3DAh before touching video memory (snow avoidance).

B653.name: find_char_in_font
B653.comment: Compares the 8-byte glyph at SS:BP with CX glyphs at ES:DI; AL := matching character (CF=1 when none) - read character in graphics modes.

B6E5.name: teletype_control_chars
B6E5.comment: AH=0Eh helpers: 07h bell (beep_hi), 0Dh CR, 08h backspace, 0Ah LF (scroll at the bottom).

B782.name: cga_char_row_addr
B782.comment: DI := row x 2 x bytes-per-row + col (x2 in 320-pixel modes) - graphics character position.

B7B1.name: set_cursor_pos_store
B7B1.comment: 40:450+page*2 := DX; when the page is active also program the CRTC cursor (cursor_to_crtc_value).

B7D3.name: cursor_to_crtc_value
B7D3.comment: CX := row x columns + col + page offset/2; BX := 0E0Fh (CRTC cursor high/low registers).

B7EA.name: crtc_write_pair
B7EA.comment: Writes CH/CL to CRTC registers BH/BL at 40:63.

B808.name: int10_05_select_page_body
B808.comment: AL < 4 and CX: computes the page start (40:44E), programs CRTC 0Ch/0Dh and the cursor for the new page.

B877.name: video_page_cursor_pos
B877.comment: DX := cursor position of page BH (40:450+page*2); ES := video segment (B3DE), AL := 40:10 | CFh.

B96B.name: scroll_text_body
B96B.comment: Scroll window (AH lines) up/down in text modes: computes source/destination rows and moves them with the attribute BH fill.

BA0D.name: scroll_fill_text
BA0D.comment: Fills the vacated rows with (BH attribute, space); waits for retrace in CGA modes.

BAE3.name: stosb_step2_fill
BAE3.comment: Stores AL every other byte (attribute or character column) CX times.

BBD6.name: is_graphics_mode
BBD6.comment: CF=1 for modes 4-6 (graphics), 0 for text modes and mode 7.

BBE4.name: cga_pixel_address
BBE4.comment: ES := B800h (B3E0); for modes 4-6: byte offset of pixel (CX, DX) with the 2000h odd-line interleave; 80 or 40 bytes per row.

C01F.name: pmode_load_flat_selectors_retf
C01F.comment: DS := 18h, ES := 20h, SS := 28h, CLC, RETF (protected-mode data selectors for the block move / memory test).

C200.name: post_code_02_restart
C200.comment: POST 02h then jump to 94B0 (CPU reset path).

C311.name: gdt_build_code_descriptor
C311.comment: Writes a code descriptor at ES:DI: limit FFFFh, base CS<<4 + BP, type 9Bh.

C344.name: pic_init_icw
C344.comment: ICW1 11h, ICW2 BH, ICW3 AH, ICW4 01h to the PIC at DX/DX+1 (port EDh delays).

C35A.name: pit_ch0_latch_read
C35A.comment: Latches PIT channel 0 (43h := 00h) and reads the count into BX.

C370.name: cache_flags_from_4B5
C370.comment: AL := 40:B5 >> 3 (cache-control bits), AH := raw byte (bit 7 = cache currently enabled).

C3A0.name: cache_apply_if_enabled
C3A0.comment: If 40:B5 bit 7: runs the cache flush/enable stubs selected by the flag bits.

C4BA.name: cache_stub_C4CA_a
C4BA.comment: jmp C4CA (cache control stub, shared code).

C56C.name: cpu_tlb_test_jmp_E740
C56C.comment: Jumps to the code island at E740 (part of cpu_tlb_test, moved there by the linker).

C587.name: cpu_tlb_test_next_set
C587.comment: ESI := (ESI+4) & 0Fh, ECX := 80h, back into the fill loop.

C62C.name: cpu_tlb_test_next_way
C62C.comment: EDI := (EDI+4) & 0Fh, ECX := 80h, back into the verify loop.

C53F.name: cpu_tlb_test_tr5_4
C53F.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C548.name: cpu_tlb_test_tr3_ebx
C548.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C54B.name: cpu_tlb_test_tr5_8
C54B.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C554.name: cpu_tlb_test_tr3_ebp
C554.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C557.name: cpu_tlb_test_tr5_C
C557.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C560.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C563.name: cpu_tlb_test_tr4_addr
C563.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C5B5.name: cpu_tlb_test_read_tr3_a
C5B5.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C5B8.name: cpu_tlb_test_verify_a
C5B8.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C5C8.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C5CB.name: cpu_tlb_test_verify_b
C5CB.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C5DB.name: cpu_tlb_test_read_tr3_c
C5DB.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C5DE.name: cpu_tlb_test_verify_c
C5DE.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C5EE.name: cpu_tlb_test_read_tr3_d
C5EE.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C5F1.name: cpu_tlb_test_verify_d
C5F1.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

C601.name: cpu_tlb_test_verify_tr4
C601.comment: Fragment of cpu_tlb_test between test-register instructions (mov tr3/tr4/tr5/tr6/tr7 shown as data bytes).

E743.name: cpu_tlb_test_island_E740
E743.comment: Code island of cpu_tlb_test (after a mov tr instruction at E740).

E753.name: cpu_tlb_test_island_E750
E753.comment: mov tr7,edi at E750 then jmp back to C5AC.

C776.name: int15_C2_pointing_dispatch
C776.comment: INT 15h AH=C2h: AL 0-7 -> jump table at C766 (int15_C2 sub-functions), else AH=01h invalid function.

C9E2.name: kbc_wait_input_empty_cx
C9E2.comment: Up to CX x 100 refresh ticks for 64h bit 1 clear.

C9F4.name: kbc_write_command_byte_ah
C9F4.comment: Command 60h then the byte AH (flushing a pending aux byte); CF=1 on timeout.

CA27.name: kbc_send_aux_byte
CA27.comment: D4h then the byte to the auxiliary device, with wait_refresh_cycles delays; used by the INT 15h C2h services.

CAB5.name: kbc_read_aux_byte
CAB5.comment: Waits (CX=61A8h polls) for 64h bits 5 and 0 (aux data available) -> AL; AH=03h CF=1 on timeout.

CCFC.name: post_display_device_select
CCFC.comment: CMOS 5Eh bits 6-7 (SETUP Display Device) -> INT 10h AX=5F51h BL=0/1/2 BH=1 (or BX=0101h) - the POST-time twin of MISER's display_device_apply.

CE71.name: a20_state_test
CE71.comment: Compares 0000:0000 with FFFF:0010 while toggling the byte: tells whether address line A20 is enabled (wrap-around present or not).

D140.name: rtc_reset_if_uip_stuck
D140.comment: If the RTC update-in-progress bit never clears: status A := 26h, status B := 82h, read C and D.

D15D.name: rtc_wait_uip_clear
D15D.comment: Polls CMOS 0Ah bit 7 up to 65536 times; CF=1 when it never clears.

D174.name: speaker_click
D174.comment: Short speaker pulse (PIT channel 2 count 254h) - used for key clicks and the memory-test tick.

D1DB.name: cmos_read_shutdown_byte
D1DB.comment: Reads CMOS 0Fh (shutdown code) with the NMI-disable bit set or clear according to ROM option AF45h bit 6.

D207.name: int_service_prologue
D207.comment: Common INT service entry: saves CX/DX/SI/DI/BP/DS/ES, stores BX in the frame, BP := caller's frame pointer.

D330.name: print_hex_nibble
D330.comment: AL low nibble -> hex digit via print_char_al_int10.

D343.name: wait_key_upper
D343.comment: INT 16h AH=0, returns the key upper-cased in AL.

D43B.name: print_string_cs_si_body
D43B.comment: Prints the NUL-terminated string at CS:SI (max 65535 chars) with print_char_al_int10.

D4D7.name: memory_test_click
D4D7.comment: Speaker pulse whose length is 40:15 (the POST memory-test click when enabled).

D522.name: wait_vsync_3xA
D522.comment: Waits for the vertical-retrace start on the status port 40:63+6, then a 19-tick delay.

D8E1.name: printer_char_int17
D8E1.comment: INT 17h AH=0 (LPT1); BL := FFh on error/time-out status.

D9C8.name: cpu_type_lookup
D9C8.comment: CH/CL (CPU signature family/model) -> cpu_type_table_search; BX := name string, AH=86h CF=1 when unknown.

D9E2.name: cpu_type_table_search
D9E2.comment: Scans cpu_type_table (D99C-D9C8, 4-byte records) for CH/CL & F0h.

5D47.name: post_reg_test_verify
5D47.comment: Verify half of the POST register write/read test loop at 5D3D (DI alternates between the write stub 5D42 and this verify stub): IN from DX must equal BL, else post_fatal_error code 06h.

63A7.name: a20_wrap_test_dword
63A7.comment: ES:[0500] := 0, FS:[0510] (FFFF:0510 = 10500h) := 1, then compares the bytes: decides whether A20 is open (protected-mode memory test prologue).

66E7.name: post_keyboard_failure_msg
66E7.comment: Prints 'Keyboard <controller|clock line|data line|stuck key> failure' (string from SI) unless ROM option AF46h bit 4 is clear or bit 3 with CMOS 0Eh bits 6-7 / CMOS 1Fh bit 0 suppress it.

CE49.name: int15_24_a20_gate_service
CE49.comment: INT 15h AH=24h (A20 gate support): AL=0 disable (gate_a20_disable), AL=1 enable, AL=2 query status (SMSW/wrap test), AL=3 report support (BX = 3: KBC and port 92h-style methods); AH=86h otherwise.

5800.name: core_copyright_string
5800.comment: 'Copyright 1985-1992  Phoenix Technologies Ltd.' at the start of the core segment (checksummed by the anti-tamper check).

58BA.name: post_kbc_reset_rom_stack
58BA.comment: ROM-stack return words / continuation used by post_kbc_reset_continue.

5E52.name: rom_stack_words_5E52
5E52.comment: Return-address words 5E2Ch, 5E56h for the ROM-stack idiom.

86CD.name: setup_far_ptr_86CD
86CD.comment: Far pointer F000:0100 (SETUP) + constants used by the hot-key path.

A1D2.name: fdc_rqm_not_ready_test
A1D2.comment: MSR 3F4h inverted; SF from bit 7 (RQM clear).

A809.name: floppy_table_A809
A809.comment: C0 FF 60 FF 60 FF 80 - per-drive-type bytes (data-rate / step, best guess).

AA14.name: floppy_drive_type_resolve
AA14.comment: Continuation of floppy_motor_check: DIR bits 6-7 -> table A9FBh index -> drive type in [bp+14].

B2E6.name: cga_box_chars_B2E6
B2E6.comment: DB B3 DB B3 DB B3 08 B8 - graphics character helpers.

B3DE.name: video_segment_words
B3DE.comment: B000h, B800h - video buffer segments for the fallback INT 10h.

C185.name: bda_4A0_bit7_test
C185.comment: AL := 40:A0 & 80h; ZF when clear (wait flag byte, INT 15h 83h/86h).

C597.name: cpu_tlb_test_verify_init
C597.comment: ECX := 80h, EDI := 2 before the verify loop.

DA36.name: cpu_speed_div_loop_retf
DA36.comment: Divide-loop timing variant (xor ax,ax; 4 x div bx; loop) ending in PIT ch2 := 0 and RETF.

93D6.name: kbc_input_full_test_cb
93D6.comment: in al,64h; test al,2; ret - condition callback passed in DX to wait_refresh_cycles (keyboard-controller input buffer still full).

C5AC.name: cpu_tlb_test_esi0
C5AC.comment: ESI := 0 then mov tr5,esi - fragment of cpu_tlb_test reached from the E750 island.

8972.name: kbd_table_offsets_8972
8972.comment: 00 08 18 28 38 - offsets into the keyboard translation tables per shift state.

B781.name: cga_bytes_per_row_x2
B781.comment: A0h (160): bytes per character row in the 80-column CGA graphics modes (used by cga_char_row_addr).

BF3C.name: const_BF3C
BF3C.comment: 30 00 01 00 - selector/offset constants used by the protected-mode entry (int15_89).

20B7.name: dead_bytes_20B7
20B7.comment: nop; cmp al,1Bh; jne (unreached remnant in the SETUP exit-menu key loop).

E05E.name: fill_E05E
E05E.comment: FFh fill between post_entry and the copyright-check area (classic IBM layout gaps between the fixed entry points).

D7F3.name: wait_cb_never
D7F3.comment: or al,1; ret - default condition callback for wait_refresh_cycles (never satisfied, so the full tick count elapses).

9021.name: kbd_ctrl_make
9021.comment: Scancode 1Dh: set the Ctrl bit (40:17 bit 2, 40:18 left/right via E0 prefix) with kbd_shift_flags_set.

9017.name: kbd_alt_make
9017.comment: 38h: Alt make -> 40:17 bit 3 (40:18 for the right Alt).

9063.name: kbd_capslock_make
9063.comment: 3Ah: toggles 40:17 bit 6 unless already held (40:18 bit 6), updates the LEDs.

908C.name: kbd_numlock_make
908C.comment: 45h: toggles Num Lock (40:17 bit 5); with Ctrl held it is Pause (40:18 bit 3 loop until a key).

90CE.name: kbd_scrolllock_make
90CE.comment: 46h: toggles Scroll Lock (40:17 bit 4); with Ctrl held it is Break (INT 1Bh, buffer flushed).

9039.name: kbd_alt_break
9039.comment: B8h: clear Alt; if an Alt+numpad code was accumulated (40:19) store it as a character.

9087.name: kbd_lock_key_break
9087.comment: BAh/C5h/C6h: clear the 'held' bits of Caps/Num/Scroll Lock in 40:18.

8D0E.name: kbd_insert_make
8D0E.comment: 52h: Insert - toggles 40:17 bit 7 when no shift is active, else stores the key.

8F31.name: kbd_overrun_FF
8F31.comment: FFh: keyboard overrun - beep and ignore.

8FE0.name: kbd_platform_key_AB
8FE0.comment: ABh: notebook-specific break code (Fn key release, best guess) - clears the platform flag.

8FF3.name: kbd_platform_key_41_85
8FF3.comment: 41h (F7) / 85h: notebook hot-key path - INT 15h AH=4Fh style dispatch to the platform handler (Fn+F7 / Fn function keys, best guess).

8F84.name: kbd_prtscr_make
8F84.comment: 37h: PrtScr make - INT 05h (print screen) unless Alt is held (then SysReq path); Ctrl+PrtScr toggles printer echo.
